title: Barron-Wiener-Laguerre models
summary: We propose a probabilistic extension of Wiener-Laguerre models for causal operator learning. Classical Wiener-Laguerre models parameterize stable linear dynamics using orthonormal Laguerre bases and apply a static nonlinear map to the resulting features. While structurally efficient and interpretable, they provide only deterministic point estimates. We reinterpret the nonlinear component through the lens of Barron function approximation, viewing two-layer networks, random Fourier features, and extreme learning machines as discretizations of integral representations over parameter measures. This perspective naturally admits Bayesian inference on the nonlinear map and yields posterior predictive uncertainty. By combining Laguerre-parameterized causal dynamics with probabilistic Barron-type nonlinear approximators, we obtain a structured yet expressive class of causal operators equipped with uncertainty quantification. The resulting framework bridges classical system identification and modern measure-based function approximation, providing a principled approach to time-series modeling and nonlinear systems identification.

AI.title_translation: Barron-Wiener-Laguerre 模型
AI.tldr: 将 Wiener-Laguerre 模型扩展为概率形式，通过 Barron 函数视角对非线性部分进行贝叶斯推断，实现具有不确定性量化的因果算子学习。
AI.motivation: 经典 Wiener-Laguerre 模型虽结构高效且可解释，但只能给出确定性点估计，缺乏对预测不确定性的量化能力。
AI.method: 用 Laguerre 基参数化稳定线性动力学，并将静态非线性映射 reinterpret 为 Barron 函数近似下的积分表示，进而对该非线性映射进行贝叶斯推理，得到后验预测分布。
AI.result: 提出的框架将 Laguerre 因果动力学与概率型 Barron 非线性逼近结合，获得一类结构化且富有表达力的因果算子，并具备不确定性量化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作连接了经典系统辨识与现代基于测度的函数近似，为时间序列建模与非线性系统辨识提供了具有不确定性量化的原则性方法。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种对 Wiener-Laguerre 模型的概率扩展，用于因果算子学习。经典的 Wiener-Laguerre 模型利用正交 Laguerre 基对稳定线性动力学进行参数化，并对所得特征施加静态非线性映射。尽管结构上高效且可解释，它们只能提供确定性点估计。我们借助 Barron 函数近似重新解释非线性组件，将双层网络、随机傅里叶特征与极限学习机视为对参数测度上积分表示的离散化。该视角自然支持对非线性映射进行贝叶斯推断，并产生后验预测不确定性。通过将 Laguerre 参数化的因果动力学与概率型 Barron 非线性逼近器结合，我们获得了一类结构化且富有表达力的因果算子，并具备不确定性量化。所得框架连接了经典系统辨识与现代基于测度的函数近似，为时间序列建模与非线性系统辨识提供了原则性的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出 Barron-Wiener-Laguerre 模型，通过把非线性部分视为 Barron 函数积分表示并施加贝叶斯推断，使经典 Wiener-Laguerre 结构获得概率输出与不确定性量化，实现更强大的因果算子学习能力。
AI.keywords: Wiener-Laguerre 模型,Barron 函数,因果算子学习,贝叶斯推断,不确定性量化,系统辨识
AI.comments: 摘要未给出具体实验结果或算法复杂度分析，建议补充实证验证与计算效率评估以强化说服力。

title: Random Forests as Statistical Procedures: Design, Variance, and Dependence
summary: Random forests are widely used prediction procedures, yet are typically described algorithmically rather than as statistical designs acting on a fixed dataset. We develop a finite-sample, design-based formulation of random forests in which each tree is an explicit randomized conditional regression function. This perspective yields an exact variance identity for the forest predictor that separates finite-aggregation variability from a structural dependence term that persists even under infinite aggregation. We further decompose both single-tree dispersion and inter-tree covariance using the laws of total variance and covariance, isolating two fundamental design mechanisms-reuse of training observations and alignment of data-adaptive partitions. These mechanisms induce a strict covariance floor, demonstrating that predictive variability cannot be eliminated by increasing the number of trees alone. The resulting framework clarifies how resampling, feature-level randomization, and split selection govern resolution, tree variability, and dependence, and establishes random forests as explicit finite-sample statistical designs whose behavior is determined by their underlying randomized construction.

AI.title_translation: 随机森林作为统计过程：设计、方差与依赖性
AI.tldr: 作者将随机森林重新表述为作用于固定数据集的显式随机化统计设计，推导出精确的方差恒等式，并证明训练样本复用与数据自适应划分对齐会引入不可通过增加树数消除的协方差下限。
AI.motivation: 现有文献多从算法角度描述随机森林，缺乏将其视为作用于固定数据集的统计设计的有限样本理论，导致对其方差来源与依赖结构理解不足。
AI.method: 建立基于设计的有限样本框架，把每棵树视为显式随机化条件回归函数；利用全方差与全协方差定律分解单树离散度与树间协方差，分离有限聚合变异与结构依赖项。

title: Intersecting Codes and the Connectivity of $q$-Matroids
summary: We investigate the structure of intersecting error-correcting codes, with a particular focus on their connection to matroid theory. We establish properties and bounds for intersecting codes with the Hamming metric and illustrate how these distinguish the subfamily of minimal codes within the family of intersecting codes. We prove that the property of a code being intersecting is characterized by the matroid-theoretic notion of vertical connectivity, showing that intersecting codes are precisely those achieving the highest possible value of this parameter. We then introduce the concept of vertical connectivity for $q$-matroids and link it to the theory of intersecting codes endowed with the rank metric.

title: AdaGrad-Diff: A New Version of the Adaptive Gradient Algorithm
summary: Vanilla gradient methods are often highly sensitive to the choice of stepsize, which typically requires manual tuning. Adaptive methods alleviate this issue and have therefore become widely used. Among them, AdaGrad has been particularly influential. In this paper, we propose an AdaGrad-style adaptive method in which the adaptation is driven by the cumulative squared norms of successive gradient differences rather than gradient norms themselves. The key idea is that when gradients vary little across iterations, the stepsize is not unnecessarily reduced, while significant gradient fluctuations, reflecting curvature or instability, lead to automatic stepsize damping. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed method is more robust than AdaGrad in several practically relevant settings.

AI.title_translation: AdaGrad-Diff：自适应梯度算法的新版本

AI.motivation: 原始梯度方法对步长选择敏感且需手工调参，AdaGrad等自适应方法虽缓解此问题，但当梯度变化较小时仍可能过度减小步长，需进一步改进。

title: A Data-Driven Algorithm for Model-Free Control Synthesis
summary: Presented is an algorithm to synthesize the optimal infinite-horizon LQR feedback controller for continuous-time systems. The algorithm does not require knowledge of the system dynamics but instead uses only a finite-length sampling of arbitrary input-output data. The algorithm is based on a constrained optimization problem that enforces a necessary condition on the dynamics of the optimal value function along any trajectory. In addition to calculating the standard LQR gain matrix, a feedforward gain can be found to implement a reference tracking controller. This paper presents a theoretical justification for the method and shows several examples, including a validation test on a real scale aircraft.

title: Complex to Rational Fast Matrix Multiplication
summary:
Fast matrix multiplication algorithms are asymptotically faster than the classical cubic-time algorithm, but they are often slower in practice. One important obstacle is the use of complex coefficients, which increases arithmetic overhead and limits practical efficiency. This paper focuses on transforming complex-coefficient matrix multiplication schemes into equivalent real- or rational-coefficient ones. We present a systematic method that, given a complex-coefficient scheme, either constructs a family of equivalent rational algorithms or proves that no equivalent rational scheme exists. Our approach relies only on basic linear-algebraic properties of similarity transformations of complex matrices. This method recovers the previously known ad hoc results of Dumas, Pernet, and Sedoglavic (2025) and extends them to more general settings, including algorithms involving rational coefficients and square roots, with $i=\sqrt{-1}$ as a special case.
  Using this framework, we show that no rational scheme is equivalent to Smirnov's $\langle4,4,9,104\rangle$ $\mathbb{Q}[\sqrt{161}]$ algorithm (2022) and that no real scheme is equivalent to the $\langle4,4,4,48\rangle$ complex algorithm of Kaporin (2024). More generally, our approach can also be used to prove the non-existence of integer-coefficient schemes.

AI.title_translation: 从复数到有理数系数的快速矩阵乘法
AI.tldr: 提出一种系统方法，将复系数快速矩阵乘法方案转化为等价的有理系数方案，并可证明某些情况下不存在有理或实系数等价方案。
AI.motivation: 现有快速矩阵乘法算法因使用复系数导致计算开销大，实际效率低，需要寻找等价的实数或有理数系数方案以提升实用性。
AI.method: 利用复矩阵相似变换的基本线性代数性质，构建一个框架：给定复系数方案，可构造等价有理算法族或证明其不存在。
AI.result: 成功恢复并推广了Dumas等人2025年的结果；证明Smirnov的⟨4,4,9,104⟩ ℚ[√161]算法不存在有理等价方案，Kaporin的⟨4,4,4,48⟩复算法不存在实等价方案；可推广至证明整数系数方案不存在。

title: Improved Regret Guarantees for Online Mirror Descent using a Portfolio of Mirror Maps
summary:
OMD and its variants give a flexible framework for OCO where the performance depends crucially on the choice of the mirror map. While the geometries underlying OPGD and OEG, both special cases of OMD, are well understood, it remains a challenging open question on how to construct an optimal mirror map for any given constrained set and a general family of loss functions, e.g., sparse losses. Motivated by parameterizing a near-optimal set of mirror maps, we consider a simpler question: is it even possible to obtain polynomial gains in regret by using mirror maps for geometries that interpolate between $L_1$ and $L_2$, which may not be possible by restricting to only OEG ($L_1$) or OPGD ($L_2$).
  Our main result answers this question positively. We show that mirror maps based on block norms adapt better to the sparsity of loss functions, compared to previous $L_p$ (for $p \in [1, 2]$) interpolations. In particular, we construct a family of online convex optimization instances in $\mathbb{R}^d$, where block norm-based mirror maps achieve a provable polynomial (in $d$) improvement in regret over OEG and OPGD for sparse loss functions. We then turn to the setting in which the sparsity level of the loss functions is unknown. In this case, the choice of geometry itself becomes an online decision problem. We first show that naively switching between OEG and OPGD can incur linear regret, highlighting the intrinsic difficulty of geometry selection. To overcome this issue, we propose a meta-algorithm based on multiplicative weights that dynamically selects among a family of uniform block norms. We show that this approach effectively tunes OMD to the sparsity of the losses, yielding adaptive regret guarantees. Overall, our results demonstrate that online mirror-map selection can significantly enhance the ability of OMD to exploit sparsity in online convex optimization.

AI.title_translation: 利用镜像映射组合改进在线镜像下降的后悔界
AI.tldr: 文章提出基于 block 范数的新镜像映射及其组合选择方法，在稀疏损失下可比传统的 OEG（L1）和 OPGD（L2）获得维度多项式级别更小的后悔，并在未知稀疏度时实现自适应几何选择。
AI.motivation: 在在线凸优化中，在线镜像下降（OMD）的性能高度依赖镜像映射（几何）的选择，但如何针对给定约束集合和可能稀疏的损失族构造“近最优”镜像映射仍是开放问题。传统的 OEG（L1 几何）和 OPGD（L2 几何）以及简单的 Lp 插值无法充分利用稀疏性，尤其不清楚是否可以通过更细致的几何插值在后悔上获得维度多项式级的收益。
AI.method: 作者引入基于 block 范数的一族镜像映射，构造在 R^d 上的在线凸优化实例，形式化比较这些 block 范数几何与 Lp（p∈[1,2]）几何在稀疏损失下的后悔表现。在已知稀疏度时，直接使用相应 block 范数的 OMD；在未知稀疏度时，将几何（即不同的均匀 block 范数）选择本身视为一个在线决策问题，提出基于乘法权重的元算法，在不同镜像映射之间动态分配权重，从而自适应选择合适的几何。
AI.result: 1）构造了一类在 R^d 上的 OCO 实例，在稀疏损失情况下，采用基于 block 范数的镜像映射的 OMD，其后悔在维度 d 上比 OEG 和 OPGD 获得可证明的多项式级改进；2）证明单纯在 OEG 与 OPGD 之间“天真切换”可能导致线性后悔，表明几何选择本身具有难度；3）提出的乘法权重元算法在未知损失稀疏度时，能够在一族均匀 block 范数之间进行在线镜像映射选择，使 OMD 的后悔自适应于损失的稀疏水平，从而得到自适应后悔保证。
AI.conclusion: 基于 block 范数的镜像映射比传统的 Lp 插值更能利用稀疏损失结构，并能在某些 OCO 实例上实现对 OEG 和 OPGD 的维度多项式级后悔改进。进一步地，通过使用乘法权重元算法在一组镜像映射之间在线选择几何，可以在未知稀疏度下获得自适应的后悔界，表明在线镜像映射选择是提升 OMD 利用稀疏性能力的有效途径。
AI.translation: OMD 及其变体为在线凸优化（OCO）提供了一个灵活的框架，其性能在很大程度上取决于镜像映射的选择。尽管 OPGD 和 OEG 这两类 OMD 特例所对应的几何结构已经被很好地理解，但对于任意给定的约束集合和一般的损失函数族（例如稀疏损失），如何构造最优镜像映射仍然是一个具有挑战性的开放问题。受到对“近最优”镜像映射族进行参数化这一目标的激励，我们先考虑一个更简单的问题：是否有可能通过使用在 L1 与 L2 之间插值的几何所对应的镜像映射，在后悔上获得多项式级的提升——而仅局限于 OEG（L1）或 OPGD（L2）时可能做不到。我们的主要结果对该问题给出了肯定的回答。我们表明，相比既往基于 Lp（p∈[1,2]）的插值，基于 block 范数的镜像映射能更好地适应损失函数的稀疏性。具体而言，我们构造了一族定义在 R^d 上的在线凸优化实例，在这些实例中，对于稀疏损失，基于 block 范数的镜像映射在后悔上可以实现相对于 OEG 和 OPGD 的维度多项式级改进。随后，我们转向损失函数稀疏度未知的情形。在该情形下，几何的选择本身成为一个在线决策问题。我们首先表明，在 OEG 与 OPGD 之间进行天真地切换会产生线性后悔，这凸显了几何选择任务本身的内在困难。为克服这一问题，我们提出了一个基于乘法权重的元算法，用于在一族均匀 block 范数之间动态选择。我们证明，该方法可以有效地将 OMD 调整为适应损失的稀疏性，从而获得自适应的后悔保证。总体而言，我们的结果表明，在线选择镜像映射可以显著提升 OMD 在在线凸优化中利用稀疏性的能力。
AI.summary: 本文研究在线镜像下降中镜像映射（几何）的选择问题，尤其是在损失函数具有稀疏结构时的最优几何设计。作者提出基于 block 范数的一族镜像映射，并构造 OCO 实例证明：在稀疏损失情形下，这些几何可在维度 d 上相对于传统 OEG 与 OPGD 获得多项式级别的后悔改进，同时优于简单的 Lp 插值方案。在损失稀疏度未知时，作者将几何选择视为在线问题，展示了简单在 OEG 与 OPGD 间切换可能导致线性后悔，并提出基于乘法权重的元算法在一组 block 范数几何中进行在线选择，实现对稀疏度的自适应调节。结果说明，通过在线镜像映射选择，OMD 在利用稀疏性方面的能力可被显著增强。
AI.keywords: 在线镜像下降, 在线凸优化, 稀疏损失, block 范数, L1 几何, L2 几何, 后悔界, 几何选择, 乘法权重, 元算法
AI.comments: 工作主要是理论性的，贡献在于给出了具体的反例和构造，证明传统 Lp 插值和简单几何切换在稀疏情形下并不最优，并用 block 范数和元学习式的几何选择获得多项式级改进和自适应后悔界。局限在于抽象理论设定下的效果在实际高维、非理想稀疏数据上的表现尚未在摘要中讨论，且对 block 结构如何与现实问题特征对齐尚未给出细节。

title: Selection of CMIP6 Models for Regional Precipitation Projection and Climate Change Assessment in the Jhelum and Chenab River Basins
summary: Effective water resource management depends on accurate projections of flows in water channels. For projected climate data, use of different General Circulation Models (GCM) simulates contrasting results. This study shows selection of GCM for the latest generation CMIP6 for hydroclimate change impact studies. Envelope based method was used for the selection, which includes components based on machine learning techniques, allowing the selection of GCMs without the need for in-situ reference data. According to our knowledge, for the first time, such a comparison was performed for the CMIP6 Shared Socioeconomic Pathway (SSP) scenarios data. In addition, the effect of climate change under SSP scenarios was studied, along with the calculation of extreme indices. Finally, GCMs were compared to quantify spatiotemporal differences between CMIP5 and CMIP6 data. Results provide NorESM2 LM, FGOALS g3 as selected models for the Jhelum and Chenab River. Highly vulnerable regions under the effect of climate change were highlighted through spatial maps, which included parts of Punjab, Jammu, and Kashmir. Upon comparison of CMIP5 and CMIP6, no discernible difference was found between the RCP and SSP scenarios precipitation projections. In the future, more detailed statistical comparisons could further reinforce the proposition.

AI.title_translation: 基于CMIP6模型优选的杰赫勒姆河与切纳布河流域区域降水预估与气候变化评估
AI.tldr: 利用无实测数据的机器学习包络法，首次在SSP情景下优选CMIP6模式；选出NorESM2-LM与FGOALS-g3，发现CMIP5/6降水预估差异不显著，并识别旁遮普等地为高脆弱区。
AI.motivation: 水资源管理亟需可靠流量预估，但不同CMIP6 GCM结果差异大；同时缺乏针对SSP情景、无需地面观测的模型优选研究。
AI.method: 采用基于机器学习的包络法，在无需实测数据条件下筛选CMIP6 GCM；比较SSP与RCP情景降水预估，并计算极端指数；对CMIP5与CMIP6进行时空差异量化。
AI.result: 优选出适用于杰赫勒姆河与切纳布流域的NorESM2-LM与FGOALS-g3；空间图显示旁遮普、查谟和克什米尔部分地区为高脆弱区；CMIP5 RCP与CMIP6 SSP降水预估无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 包络法可有效无观测优选CMIP6模式；所选模型可用于流域水文气候变化影响研究；CMIP5与CMIP6降水预估差异不显著，未来需更精细统计验证。
AI.translation: 有效水资源管理依赖于河道流量的准确预估。不同GCM对气候数据模拟结果迥异。本研究为最新CMIP6遴选GCM用于水文气候变化影响研究，采用基于机器学习的包络法，无需实测参考数据即可优选。据我们所知，首次对CMIP6 SSP情景数据进行此类比较，并研究SSP情景下气候变化效应及极端指数，量化CMIP5与CMIP6时空差异。结果推荐NorESM2-LM与FGOALS-g3为杰赫勒姆与切纳布流域适用模型，空间图高亮旁遮普、查谟和克什米尔为高脆弱区，CMIP5 RCP与CMIP6 SSP降水预估无显著差异，未来可进一步统计验证。
AI.summary: 本研究提出无实测数据的机器学习包络法，首次在SSP情景下优选CMIP6模式，推荐NorESM2-LM与FGOALS-g3用于杰赫勒姆与切纳布流域，发现CMIP5/6降水预估差异不显著，并识别旁遮普等地为高脆弱区。
AI.keywords: CMIP6；SSP情景；包络法；机器学习；降水预估；气候变化；杰赫勒姆河；切纳布河
AI.comments: 研究首次在无观测条件下完成CMIP6 SSP优选，方法具推广潜力；但仅基于包络法，缺乏多指标综合评估，且未深入探讨温度与径流响应，未来可结合降尺度与多变量验证。

title: Online Monitoring of Metric Temporal Logic using Sequential Networks
summary: Metric Temporal Logic (MTL) is a popular formalism to specify temporal patterns with timing constraints over the behavior of cyber-physical systems with application areas ranging in property-based testing, robotics, optimization, and learning. This paper focuses on the unified construction of sequential networks from MTL specifications over discrete and dense time behaviors to provide an efficient and scalable online monitoring framework. Our core technique, future temporal marking, utilizes interval-based symbolic representations of future discrete and dense timelines. Building upon this, we develop efficient update and output functions for sequential network nodes for timed temporal operations. Finally, we extensively test and compare our proposed technique with existing approaches and runtime verification tools. Results highlight the performance and scalability advantages of our monitoring approach and sequential networks.

AI.title_translation: 基于时序网络的度量时序逻辑在线监控
AI.tldr: 提出一种将MTL规范统一转换为时序网络的方法，实现离散与稠密时间行为的高效在线监控。
AI.motivation: 现有MTL在线监控方法在处理离散与稠密时间行为时缺乏统一且可扩展的框架，需要更高效且可伸缩的监控技术。
AI.method: 提出“未来时间标记”技术，用基于区间的符号化表示未来离散与稠密时间线，并设计时序网络节点的高效更新与输出函数。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在性能与可扩展性上优于现有方法与运行时验证工具。
AI.conclusion: 基于时序网络的MTL在线监控框架兼具高效性与可扩展性，适用于多种应用场景。
AI.translation: 度量时序逻辑（MTL）是一种为信息物理系统行为指定带时间约束的时序模式的流行形式化方法，应用于基于属性的测试、机器人、优化与学习等领域。本文聚焦于将MTL规范统一构建为适用于离散与稠密时间行为的时序网络，以提供高效且可扩展的在线监控框架。核心技巧“未来时间标记”利用基于区间的符号化表示未来的离散与稠密时间线。基于此，我们为时序时序操作开发时序网络节点的高效更新与输出函数。最后，我们广泛测试并比较所提方法与现有方法和运行时验证工具，结果突显了本监控方法与序网络的性能与可扩展优势。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种统一框架，将MTL规范转换为序网络，实现离散与稠密时间行为的在线监控。核心贡献包括未来时间标记技术、基于区间的符号化时间线表示及高效节点更新输出函数。实验验证其在性能与可扩展性上优于现有工具。
AI.keywords: 度量时序逻辑, 在线监控, 时序网络, 未来时间标记, 运行时验证
AI.comments: 未提及具体实验规模与硬件环境，亦未讨论方法的理论复杂度界限。

title: DART: aDaptive Accept RejecT for non-linear top-K subset identification
summary: We consider the bandit problem of selecting $K$ out of $N$ arms at each time step. The reward can be a non-linear function of the rewards of the selected individual arms. The direct use of a multi-armed bandit algorithm requires choosing among $\binom{N}{K}$ options, making the action space large. To simplify the problem, existing works on combinatorial bandits {typically} assume feedback as a linear function of individual rewards. In this paper, we prove the lower bound for top-$K$ subset selection with bandit feedback with possibly correlated rewards. We present a novel algorithm for the combinatorial setting without using individual arm feedback or requiring linearity of the reward function. Additionally, our algorithm works on correlated rewards of individual arms. Our algorithm, aDaptive Accept RejecT (DART), sequentially finds good arms and eliminates bad arms based on confidence bounds. DART is computationally efficient and uses storage linear in $N$. Further, DART achieves a regret bound of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(K\sqrt{KNT})$ for a time horizon $T$, which matches the lower bound in bandit feedback up to a factor of $\sqrt{\log{2NT}}$. When applied to the problem of cross-selling optimization and maximizing the mean of individual rewards, the performance of the proposed algorithm surpasses that of state-of-the-art algorithms. We also show that DART significantly outperforms existing methods for both linear and non-linear joint reward environments.

AI.title_translation: DART：面向非线性Top-K子集识别的自适应接受-拒绝算法
AI.tldr: 提出DART算法，在无需线性奖励假设和个体臂反馈的情况下，高效解决组合多臂赌博机Top-K子集选择问题，并达到近优遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 现有组合赌博机方法多依赖线性奖励假设且需个体臂反馈，难以处理非线性联合奖励和相关臂场景，导致动作空间爆炸与理论性能不足。
AI.method: 设计DART算法，通过置信界依次接受优臂、淘汰劣臂，无需线性奖励或个体反馈，存储仅O(N)，计算高效。
AI.result: DART在T步内获得 regrets 上界Õ(K√KNT)，与下界仅差√log(2NT)；在交叉销售与均值最大化任务中优于现有算法，对线性/非线性环境均显著领先。
AI.conclusion: DART首次在无需线性假设和个体反馈下解决相关臂Top-K组合赌博机，理论最优且实验优越，可推广至更复杂组合决策。
AI.translation: 我们研究每步从N个臂中选K个的组合赌博机问题，其奖励可为选中臂奖励的非线性函数。直接使用多臂赌博机需在C(N,K)动作空间选择，规模巨大。现有工作多假设反馈为个体奖励线性函数。本文证明带赌博机反馈的Top-K子集选择下界，提出无需个体臂反馈且不要求奖励线性的新算法aDaptive Accept RejecT (DART)。DART通过置信界序贯找优臂、淘汰劣臂，计算高效且存储仅O(N)。其遗憾界Õ(K√KNT)匹配下界至多√log(2NT)因子。在交叉销售与均值最大化实验中，DART性能优于最新算法，对线性/非线性联合奖励环境均显著领先。
AI.summary: DART算法突破线性奖励与个体反馈限制，以O(N)存储和Õ(K√KNT)遗憾解决Top-K组合赌博机，理论匹配下界，实验全面领先。
AI.keywords: 组合多臂赌博机,Top-K子集选择,非线性奖励,自适应接受-拒绝,遗憾界,相关臂
AI.comments: 摘要未提算法并行化、超参数敏感性及真实世界部署细节。

title: Spatio-Temporal driven Attention Graph Neural Network with Block Adjacency matrix (STAG-NN-BA) for Remote Land-use Change Detection
summary: Land-use monitoring is fundamental for spatial planning, particularly in view of compound impacts of growing global populations and climate change. Despite existing applications of deep learning in land use monitoring, standard convolutional kernels in deep neural networks limit the applications of these networks to the Euclidean domain only. Considering the geodesic nature of the measurement of the earth's surface, remote sensing is one such area that can benefit from non-Euclidean and spherical domains. For this purpose, we designed a novel Graph Neural Network architecture for spatial and spatio-temporal classification using satellite imagery to acquire insights into socio-economic indicators. We propose a hybrid attention method to learn the relative importance of irregular neighbors in remote sensing data. Instead of classifying each pixel, we propose a method based on Simple Linear Iterative Clustering (SLIC) image segmentation and Graph Attention Network. The superpixels obtained from SLIC become the nodes of our Graph Convolution Network (GCN). A region adjacency graph (RAG) is then constructed where each superpixel is connected to every other adjacent superpixel in the image, enabling information to propagate globally. Finally, we propose a Spatially driven Attention Graph Neural Network (SAG-NN) to classify each RAG. We also propose an extension to our SAG-NN for spatio-temporal data. Unlike regular grids of pixels in images, superpixels are irregular in nature and cannot be used to create spatio-temporal graphs. We introduce temporal bias by combining unconnected RAGs from each image into one supergraph. This is achieved by introducing block adjacency matrices resulting in novel Spatio-Temporal driven Attention Graph Neural Network with Block Adjacency matrix (STAG-NN-BA). SAG-NN and STAG-NN-BA outperform graph and non-graph baselines on Asia14 and C2D2 datasets efficiently.

AI.title_translation: 空间-时间驱动的带有块邻接矩阵的注意力图神经网络（STAG-NN-BA）用于遥感土地利用变化检测
AI.tldr: 提出STAG-NN-BA，一种基于超像素分割和图注意力网络的空间-时间图神经网络，用于遥感土地利用变化检测，在非欧几里得域中优于基线模型。
AI.motivation: 土地利用监测对空间规划至关重要，尤其是在全球人口增长和气候变化的复合影响下。现有深度学习方法受限于欧几里得域，而遥感数据具有非欧几里得和球面特性，需要新的方法来处理。
AI.method: 设计了一种新颖的图神经网络架构，用于空间和时空分类。提出混合注意力方法学习不规则邻居的重要性。通过SLIC图像分割将超像素作为图卷积网络（GCN）的节点，构建区域邻接图（RAG）。提出空间驱动注意力图神经网络（SAG-NN）对RAG进行分类。为时空数据扩展SAG-NN，通过引入块邻接矩阵将来自每幅图像的未连接RAG组合成一个超图，形成STAG-NN-BA。
AI.result: SAG-NN 和 STAG-NN-BA 在 Asia14 和 C2D2 数据集上高效地优于图和非图基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种新颖的STAG-NN-BA模型，通过结合超像素分割、图注意力网络和块邻接矩阵，有效地解决了遥感土地利用变化检测中的非欧几里得数据处理问题，并在多个数据集上表现出优越性能。
AI.translation: 土地利用监测对空间规划至关重要，特别是在全球人口增长和气候变化的复合影响下。尽管深度学习在土地利用监测中已有应用，但深度神经网络中的标准卷积核将这些网络的应用程序仅限于欧几里得域。考虑到地球表面测量的测地线性质，遥感是这样一个领域，可以受益于非欧几里得和球面域。为此，我们设计了一种新颖的图神经网络架构，用于使用卫星图像进行空间和时空分类，以获取对社会经济指标的洞察。我们提出了一种混合注意力方法来学习遥感数据中不规则邻居的相对重要性。我们不分类每个像素，而是提出一种基于简单线性迭代聚类（SLIC）图像分割和图注意力网络的方法。从SLIC获得的超像素成为我们图卷积网络（GCN）的节点。然后构建区域邻接图（RAG），其中每个超像素连接到图像中所有其他相邻超像素，从而使信息能够全局传播。最后，我们提出了一种空间驱动注意力图神经网络（SAG-NN）来对每个RAG进行分类。我们还提出了对我们的SAG-NN的时空数据扩展。与图像中的常规像素网格不同，超像素本质上是不规则的，不能用于创建时空图。我们通过将来自每幅图像的未连接RAG组合成一个超图来引入时间偏差。这是通过引入块邻接矩阵实现的，从而产生了新颖的带有块邻接矩阵的空间-时间驱动注意力图神经网络（STAG-NN-BA）。SAG-NN 和 STAG-NN-BA 在 Asia14 和 C2D2 数据集上高效地优于图和非图基线模型。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的空间-时间驱动的注意力图神经网络（STAG-NN-BA）模型，用于遥感土地利用变化检测。该方法通过SLIC分割将图像转换为超像素节点，构建区域邻接图（RAG），并利用空间驱动注意力图神经网络（SAG-NN）进行分类。为处理时空数据，STAG-NN-BA引入块邻接矩阵，将不同时间步的RAGs整合为超图，有效解决了遥感数据非欧几里得特性带来的挑战。实验结果表明，SAG-NN和STAG-NN-BA在Asia14和C2D2数据集上优于现有基线模型。
AI.keywords: 土地利用变化检测, 图神经网络, 空间-时间注意力, 超像素分割, 块邻接矩阵
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将图神经网络应用于遥感土地利用变化检测，特别是在非欧几里得域数据处理方面。通过SLIC超像素分割和引入块邻接矩阵来处理时空数据，使得模型能够有效捕捉不规则空间和时间依赖性。这种方法为理解和监测复杂的地球表面变化提供了新的视角和工具，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Direct Access for Conjunctive Queries with Negations
comments: 53 pages Invited LMCS submission - typeset version
summary:
Given a conjunctive query $Q$ and a database $D$, a direct access to the answers of $Q$ over $D$ is the operation of returning, given an index $k$, the $k$-th answer for some order on its answers. While this problem is $\#\mathcal{P}$-hard in general with respect to combined complexity, many conjunctive queries have an underlying structure that allows for a direct access to their answers for some lexicographical ordering that takes polylogarithmic time in the size of the database after a polynomial time precomputation. Previous work has precisely characterised the tractable classes and given fine-grained lower bounds on the precomputation time needed depending on the structure of the query.
  In this paper, we generalise these tractability results to the case of signed conjunctive queries, that is, conjunctive queries that may contain negative atoms. Our technique is based on a class of circuits that can represent relational data. We first show that this class supports tractable direct access after a polynomial time preprocessing. We then give bounds on the size of the circuit needed to represent the answer set of signed conjunctive queries depending on their structure. Both results combined together allow us to prove the tractability of direct access for a large class of conjunctive queries. On the one hand, we recover the known tractable classes from the literature in the case of positive conjunctive queries. On the other hand, we generalise and unify known tractability results about negative conjunctive queries -- that is, queries having only negated atoms. In particular, we show that the class of $β$-acyclic negative conjunctive queries and the class of bounded nest set width negative conjunctive queries admit tractable direct access.
comment: 53 pages Invited LMCS submission - typeset version

AI.title_translation: 带有否定词的合取查询的直接访问
AI.tldr: 本文将合取查询的直接访问的可处理性结果推广到带有否定原子（有符号合取查询）的情况，通过基于电路的技术，证明了这类查询在大类中具有可处理的直接访问，并统一和推广了现有结果。
AI.motivation: 现有工作已经表征了正合取查询的可处理类，但对于带有否定原子的合取查询（有符号合取查询）的直接访问问题，其可处理性尚未完全解决。直接访问在一般情况下是#P-hard的，但许多查询具有允许直接访问的底层结构。
AI.method: 1. 引入一类可以表示关系数据的电路。2. 证明这类电路在多项式时间预处理后支持可处理的直接访问。3. 根据有符号合取查询的结构，给出表示其答案集所需的电路大小的界限。4. 结合这两个结果来证明一大类合取查询的直接访问的可处理性。
AI.result: 1. 将直接访问的可处理性结果推广到有符号合取查询（包含否定原子的合取查询）。2. 证明所提出的电路类在多项式时间预处理后支持可处理的直接访问。3. 给出了表示有符号合取查询答案集所需的电路大小的界限。4. 恢复了文献中已知的所有正合取查询的可处理类。5. 推广并统一了关于负合取查询（仅包含否定原子）的已知可处理性结果。6. 特别地，证明了$\beta$-非循环负合取查询和有界嵌套集宽度负合取查询类允许可处理的直接访问。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将合取查询的直接访问的可处理性结果推广到了包含否定原子的有符号合取查询，并通过基于电路的新技术，统一并扩展了现有关于正合取查询和负合取查询的可处理性结果，从而证明了更大一类合取查询的直接访问是可处理的。
AI.translation:
给定一个合取查询$Q$和一个数据库$D$，对$D$上$Q$的答案进行直接访问的操作是，给定一个索引$k$，返回其答案某种顺序下的第$k$个答案。虽然这个问题在组合复杂度方面通常是#P-hard的，但许多合取查询具有底层结构，允许在多项式时间预计算后，以数据库大小的多对数时间直接访问其答案，对于某些字典序而言。以前的工作已经精确地表征了可处理类，并根据查询的结构给出了所需的预计算时间的细粒度下界。
在本文中，我们将这些可处理性结果推广到有符号合取查询的情况，即可能包含否定原子的合取查询。我们的技术基于一类可以表示关系数据的电路。我们首先展示这类电路在多项式时间预处理后支持可处理的直接访问。然后，我们根据有符号合取查询的结构，给出表示其答案集所需的电路大小的界限。这两个结果结合在一起，使我们能够证明一大类合取查询的直接访问的可处理性。一方面，我们恢复了文献中已知的所有正合取查询的可处理类。另一方面，我们推广并统一了关于负合取查询——即仅包含否定原子的查询——的已知可处理性结果。特别是，我们展示了$\beta$-非循环负合取查询和有界嵌套集宽度负合取查询类允许可处理的直接访问。
AI.summary: 本文研究了带有否定原子的合取查询（有符号合取查询）的直接访问问题，该问题通常是#P-hard。作者提出了一种基于电路的新技术，证明了这类电路在多项式时间预处理后能够支持可处理的直接访问。通过结合电路大小的界限，本文成功地将现有关于正合取查询的可处理性结果推广到有符号合取查询，并统一和扩展了关于负合取查询的已知可处理性结果，特别地，指出了$\beta$-非循环和有界嵌套集宽度负合取查询的可处理性。
AI.keywords: 合取查询, 直接访问, 否定, 可处理性, 电路
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将直接访问的可处理性研究从正合取查询推广到更复杂的有符号合取查询，特别是引入了基于电路的技术来解决这一问题。这种方法不仅统一了现有关于正负合取查询的理论，还识别了新的可处理类，对于理解和优化数据库查询处理具有重要意义。其挑战在于如何有效地构建和利用这些电路来表示和访问复杂的查询结果。

title: Asynchronous Composition of LTL Properties over Infinite and Finite Traces
summary:
The verification of asynchronous software components poses significant challenges due to the way components interleave and exchange input/output data concurrently. Compositional strategies aim to address this by separating the task of verifying individual components on local properties from the task of combining them to achieve global properties. This paper concentrates on employing symbolic model checking techniques to verify properties specified in Linear-time Temporal Logic (LTL) on asynchronous software components that interact through data ports. Unlike event-based composition, local properties can now impose constraints on input from other components, increasing the complexity of their composition. We consider both the standard semantics over infinite traces as well as the truncated semantics over finite traces to allow scheduling components only finitely many times.

We propose a novel LTL rewriting approach, which converts a local property into a global one while considering the interleaving of infinite or finite execution traces of components. We prove the semantic equivalence of local properties and their rewritten version projected on the local symbols. The rewriting is also optimized to reduce formula size and to leave it unchanged when the temporal property is stutter invariant. These methods have been integrated into the OCRA tool, as part of the contract refinement verification suite. Finally, the different composition approaches were compared through an experimental evaluation that covers various types of specifications.

AI.title_translation: LTL属性在无限和有限轨迹上的异步组合
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的LTL重写方法，用于异步软件组件的组合验证，将局部属性转换为全局属性，同时考虑无限和有限执行轨迹的交错，并已集成到OCRA工具中进行实验评估。
AI.motivation: 异步软件组件的验证因组件交错和并发数据交换而面临重大挑战。组合策略旨在通过分离局部属性的单个组件验证和全局属性的组合来解决此问题。本文专注于使用符号模型检查技术来验证通过数据端口交互的异步软件组件上的LTL属性，特别是在局部属性可以对来自其他组件的输入施加约束时，组合复杂性增加。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的LTL重写方法，该方法将局部属性转换为全局属性，同时考虑组件的无限或有限执行轨迹的交错。该方法证明了局部属性及其在局部符号上投影的重写版本之间的语义等价性。重写过程也经过优化，以减少公式大小并在时间属性是停顿不变时保持不变。
AI.result: 成功开发并实现了LTL重写方法，该方法能够将异步组件的局部LTL属性转换为全局属性，并证明了其语义等价性。该方法经过优化以减少公式大小，并已集成到OCRA工具中。通过实验评估，比较了不同的组合方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种有效的LTL重写方法，用于异步软件组件的组合验证，解决了局部属性对输入施加约束时的复杂性问题。该方法在理论上证明了语义等价性，并通过优化和工具集成展示了其实用性，并通过实验评估了其性能。
AI.translation:
异步软件组件的验证由于组件的交错和并发输入/输出数据交换而带来了重大挑战。组合策略旨在通过将单个组件在局部属性上的验证任务与将它们组合以实现全局属性的任务分开来解决这个问题。本文专注于采用符号模型检查技术来验证通过数据端口交互的异步软件组件上的线性时间时态逻辑（LTL）中指定的属性。与基于事件的组合不同，局部属性现在可以对来自其他组件的输入施加约束，从而增加了其组合的复杂性。我们考虑了无限轨迹上的标准语义以及有限轨迹上的截断语义，以允许组件只调度有限次。
我们提出了一种新颖的LTL重写方法，该方法将局部属性转换为全局属性，同时考虑组件的无限或有限执行轨迹的交错。我们证明了局部属性及其在局部符号上投影的重写版本之间的语义等价性。重写也经过优化，以减少公式大小并在时间属性是停顿不变时保持不变。这些方法已集成到OCRA工具中，作为契约细化验证套件的一部分。最后，通过涵盖各种规范类型的实验评估，比较了不同的组合方法。
AI.summary: 本文针对异步软件组件的验证挑战，提出了一种基于符号模型检查和LTL重写的新型组合验证策略。该方法将局部LTL属性转换为全局属性，同时考虑组件的无限或有限执行轨迹的交错，并证明了语义等价性。重写过程经过优化以减小公式大小，并已集成到OCRA工具中，通过实验评估验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 异步组件, LTL属性, 组合验证, 符号模型检查, LTL重写
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个新颖的LTL重写方法，有效地解决了异步组件验证中局部属性对输入施加约束的复杂性问题。通过考虑无限和有限轨迹的语义，并将其集成到现有工具中进行实验验证，该研究为异步软件的组合验证提供了一个实用的解决方案。

title: Composite Learning Backstepping Control With Provable Exponential Stability and Robustness
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Adaptive backstepping control provides a feasible solution to achieve asymptotic tracking for mismatched uncertain nonlinear systems. However, the closed-loop stability depends on high-gain feedback generated by nonlinear damping terms, and closed-loop exponential stability with parameter convergence involves a stringent condition named persistent excitation (PE). This paper proposes a composite learning backstepping control (CLBC) strategy based on modular backstepping and high-order tuners to compensate for the transient process of parameter estimation and achieve closed-loop exponential stability without the nonlinear damping terms and the PE condition. A novel composite learning mechanism is designed to maximize the staged exciting strength for parameter estimation, such that parameter convergence can be achieved under a condition of interval excitation (IE) or even partial IE that is strictly weaker than PE. An extra prediction error is employed in the adaptive law to ensure the transient performance without nonlinear damping terms. The exponential stability of the closed-loop system is proved rigorously under the partial IE or IE condition. Simulations have demonstrated the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method in both parameter estimation and control compared to state-of-the-art methods.
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

AI.title_translation: 复合学习反步控制，具有可证明的指数稳定性和鲁棒性
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种复合学习反步控制（CLBC）策略，无需非线性阻尼项和持续激励条件，即可实现闭环指数稳定性和参数收敛。
AI.motivation: 传统的自适应反步控制在实现闭环指数稳定性和参数收敛时，依赖于高增益反馈（由非线性阻尼项产生）和严格的持续激励（PE）条件，这限制了其应用。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种基于模块化反步和高阶调节器的复合学习反步控制（CLBC）策略。该方法设计了一种新的复合学习机制，通过最大化分阶段激励强度，在弱于PE的区间激励（IE）或部分IE条件下实现参数收敛。同时，自适应律中采用额外的预测误差来确保瞬态性能，避免了非线性阻尼项。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，与现有技术相比，所提出的方法在参数估计和控制方面均表现出有效性和优越性。闭环系统的指数稳定性在部分IE或IE条件下得到了严格证明。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的复合学习反步控制（CLBC）策略，通过创新的学习机制和误差补偿，成功地在无需非线性阻尼项和严格持续激励（PE）条件的情况下，实现了失配不确定非线性系统的闭环指数稳定性和参数收敛，并在仿真中验证了其优越性。
AI.translation: 自适应反步控制为实现失配不确定非线性系统的渐近跟踪提供了一种可行的解决方案。然而，闭环稳定性依赖于非线性阻尼项产生的高增益反馈，并且具有参数收敛的闭环指数稳定性需要一个严格的条件，即持续激励（PE）。本文提出了一种基于模块化反步和高阶调节器的复合学习反步控制（CLBC）策略，以补偿参数估计的瞬态过程，并在无需非线性阻尼项和PE条件的情况下实现闭环指数稳定性。设计了一种新颖的复合学习机制，以最大化参数估计的分阶段激励强度，从而在严格弱于PE的区间激励（IE）甚至部分IE条件下实现参数收敛。自适应律中采用额外的预测误差来确保无需非线性阻尼项的瞬态性能。在部分IE或IE条件下，闭环系统的指数稳定性得到了严格证明。仿真结果表明，与现有技术相比，所提出的方法在参数估计和控制方面均表现出有效性和优越性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种复合学习反步控制（CLBC）策略，旨在解决传统自适应反步控制中对高增益反馈和严格持续激励（PE）条件的依赖。CLBC通过结合模块化反步和高阶调节器，设计了一种新颖的复合学习机制，以在更弱的区间激励（IE）或部分IE条件下实现参数收敛。此外，自适应律中引入额外的预测误差，以在不使用非线性阻尼项的情况下确保瞬态性能。该方法被证明具有闭环指数稳定性，并在仿真中展示了其在参数估计和控制方面优于现有技术的性能。
AI.keywords: 复合学习反步控制, 指数稳定性, 参数收敛, 区间激励, 非线性系统
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个无需传统持续激励（PE）条件和非线性阻尼项的复合学习反步控制框架。通过引入更弱的激励条件（IE或部分IE）和预测误差补偿，显著降低了实现指数稳定性和参数收敛的严格性，提高了自适应控制在实际应用中的可行性和鲁棒性，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: Representing Guardedness in Call-by-Value and Guarded Parametrized Monads
summary: Like the notion of computation via (strong) monads serves to classify various flavours of impurity, including exceptions, non-determinism, probability, local and global store, the notion of guardedness classifies well-behavedness of cycles in various settings. In its most general form, the guardedness discipline applies to general symmetric monoidal categories and further specializes to Cartesian and co-Cartesian categories, where it governs guarded recursion and guarded iteration, respectively. Here, even more specifically, we deal with the semantics of call-by-value guarded iteration. It was shown by Levy, Power and Thielecke that call-by-value languages can be generally interpreted in Freyd categories, but in order to represent effectful function spaces, such a category must canonically arise from a strong monad. We generalize this fact by showing that representing guarded effectful function spaces calls for certain parameterized monads (in the sense of Uustalu). This provides a description of guardedness as an intrinsic categorical property of programs, complementing the existing description of guardedness as a predicate on a category.

AI.title_translation: 在传值调用和受保护参数化幺半群中表示受保护性
AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了在传值调用和受保护参数化幺半群中，如何将“受保护性”（guardedness）表示为程序的内在范畴性质，通过推广现有理论，使用参数化幺半群来描述受保护的效应函数空间。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将幺半群用于分类计算中的杂质（如异常、非确定性等），而“受保护性”则用于分类循环的良好行为。该论文的动机是，虽然Levy、Power和Thielecke的工作表明传值语言可在Freyd范畴中解释，且效应函数空间需要强幺半群，但缺少一种描述“受保护的效应函数空间”的方法。因此，该研究旨在推广这一事实，以将受保护性表示为程序的内在范畴性质。
AI.method: 该研究通过推广Levy、Power和Thielecke关于传值语言在Freyd范畴中解释以及效应函数空间需要强幺半群的发现。具体地，论文展示了表示受保护的效应函数空间需要使用特定的参数化幺半群（Uustalu的意义上）。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，通过使用参数化幺半群，可以描述受保护的效应函数空间。这提供了一种将受保护性描述为程序的内在范畴性质的方法，补充了现有将其描述为范畴上的谓词的方法。
AI.conclusion: 该论文的结论是，通过引入参数化幺半群，成功地将受保护性表示为传值调用语言中程序的内在范畴性质，从而提供了一种更深层次的理解，超越了将其视为范畴上谓词的传统视角。
AI.translation: 像通过（强）幺半群计算的概念用于分类各种杂质（包括异常、非确定性、概率、局部和全局存储）一样，受保护性的概念在各种设置中分类循环的良好行为。在其最一般的形式中，受保护性原则适用于一般的对称幺半群范畴，并进一步专门化为笛卡尔和共笛卡尔范畴，分别管理受保护递归和受保护迭代。在这里，更具体地说，我们处理传值调用受保护迭代的语义。Levy、Power和Thielecke的研究表明，传值调用语言通常可以在Freyd范畴中解释，但为了表示有效应的函数空间，这样的范畴必须规范地产生于一个强幺半群。我们通过展示表示受保护的有效应函数空间需要某些参数化幺半群（Uustalu的意义上）来推广这一事实。这提供了一种将受保护性描述为程序的内在范畴性质的方法，补充了现有将其描述为范畴上谓词的方法。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了在传值调用语义下，如何通过参数化幺半群来表示“受保护性”（guardedness）。受保护性用于描述循环的良好行为，类似于幺半群用于分类计算中的副作用。论文推广了现有理论，即效应函数空间需强幺半群，提出受保护的效应函数空间需要参数化幺半群。这使得受保护性能够被描述为程序的内在范畴性质，而非仅仅是范畴上的谓词。
AI.keywords: 受保护性, 传值调用, 参数化幺半群, 范畴论, 效应函数空间
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于，它将受保护性从一个外在的谓词提升为程序的内在范畴性质，通过引入参数化幺半群来处理受保护的效应函数空间。这为理解和形式化具有循环结构和副作用的程序提供了更深刻的范畴学基础，可能对编程语言理论和形式化方法产生重要影响。

title: Online Locality Meets Distributed Quantum Computing
comments: 69 pages. This version corrects mistakes in previous versions
summary:
We connect three distinct lines of research that have recently explored extensions of the classical LOCAL model of distributed computing: A. distributed quantum computing and non-signaling distributions [e.g. STOC 2024], B. finitely-dependent processes [e.g. Forum Math. Pi 2016], and C. locality in online graph algorithms and dynamic graph algorithms [e.g. ICALP 2023].
  We prove new results on the capabilities and limitations of all of these models of computing, for locally checkable labeling problems (LCLs). We show that all these settings can be sandwiched between the classical LOCAL model and what we call the randomized online-LOCAL model. Our work implies limitations on the quantum advantage in the distributed setting, and we also exhibit a new barrier for proving tighter bounds. Our main technical results are these: 1. All LCL problems solvable with locality $O(\log^\star n)$ in the classical deterministic LOCAL model admit a finitely-dependent distribution with locality $O(1)$. This answers an open question by Holroyd [2024], and also presents a new barrier for proving bounds on distributed quantum advantage using causality-based arguments. 2. In rooted trees, if we can solve an LCL problem with locality $o(\log \log \log n)$ in the randomized online-LOCAL model (or any of the weaker models, such as quantum-LOCAL), we can solve it with locality $O(\log^\star n)$ in the classical deterministic LOCAL model. One of many implications is that in rooted trees, $O(\log^\star n)$ locality in quantum-LOCAL is not stronger than $O(\log^\star n)$ locality in classical LOCAL.
