title: SmartGuard: Leveraging Large Language Models for Network Attack Detection through Audit Log Analysis and Summarization
summary: End-point monitoring solutions are widely deployed in today's enterprise environments to support advanced attack detection and investigation. These monitors continuously record system-level activities as audit logs and provide deep visibility into security events. Unfortunately, existing methods of semantic analysis based on audit logs have low granularity, only reaching the system call level, making it difficult to effectively classify highly covert behaviors. Additionally, existing works mainly match audit log streams with rule knowledge bases describing behaviors, which heavily rely on expertise and lack the ability to detect unknown attacks and provide interpretive descriptions. In this paper, we propose SmartGuard, an automated method that combines abstracted behaviors from audit event semantics with large language models. SmartGuard extracts specific behaviors (function level) from incoming system logs and constructs a knowledge graph, divides events by threads, and combines event summaries with graph embeddings to achieve information diagnosis and provide explanatory narratives through large language models. Our evaluation shows that SmartGuard achieves an average F1 score of 96\% in assessing malicious behaviors and demonstrates good scalability across multiple models and unknown attacks. It also possesses excellent fine-tuning capabilities, allowing experts to assist in timely system updates.

AI.title_translation: SmartGuard：利用大语言模型通过审计日志分析与摘要实现网络攻击检测
AI.tldr: 提出SmartGuard，将审计日志抽象为行为知识图谱，结合大语言模型进行语义诊断与解释，实现96% F1检测率并可发现未知攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有基于审计日志的语义分析方法粒度粗（仅系统调用级），难以识别高度隐蔽行为；规则匹配依赖专家知识，无法检测未知攻击且缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 1) 从系统日志提取函数级行为并构建知识图谱；2) 按线程划分事件，将事件摘要与图嵌入结合；3) 利用大语言模型进行信息诊断并生成解释性叙述。
AI.result: SmartGuard在评估中平均F1达96%，对多模型与未知攻击表现良好，具备可扩展性与快速微调能力，支持专家即时更新。
AI.conclusion: 通过将审计日志语义抽象与大语言模型结合，SmartGuard显著提升攻击检测精度与可解释性，为未知攻击检测提供自动化、可扩展的解决方案。
AI.translation: 端点监控方案已在企业广泛部署，用于高级攻击检测与调查；其持续记录系统级活动形成审计日志。然而，现有基于审计日志的语义分析粒度低，仅达系统调用级，难以有效分类高度隐蔽行为；且主要依赖规则知识库匹配，缺乏检测未知攻击与解释能力。本文提出SmartGuard，自动将审计事件语义抽象行为与大语言模型结合，提取函数级行为构建知识图谱，按线程划分事件并结合图嵌入实现信息诊断与解释性叙述。评估显示SmartGuard平均F1达96%，在多模型与未知攻击下表现良好，具备优秀微调能力供专家及时更新。
AI.summary: SmartGuard通过函数级行为提取、知识图谱构建与大语言模型融合，实现高精度、可解释的未知攻击检测，F1达96%，支持企业端点监控的自动化与可扩展升级。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型；审计日志；网络攻击检测；知识图谱；行为语义；未知攻击；可解释性
AI.comments: 摘要未提具体实验数据集、模型规模与推理延迟，亦未说明实际部署开销与隐私风险。

title: CP-uniGuard: A Unified, Probability-Agnostic, and Adaptive Framework for Malicious Agent Detection and Defense in Multi-Agent Embodied Perception Systems
comments: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing (TMC)
summary: Collaborative Perception (CP) has been shown to be a promising technique for multi-agent autonomous driving and multi-agent robotic systems, where multiple agents share their perception information to enhance the overall perception performance and expand the perception range. However, in CP, an ego agent needs to receive messages from its collaborators, which makes it vulnerable to attacks from malicious agents. To address this critical issue, we propose a unified, probability-agnostic, and adaptive framework, namely, CP-uniGuard, which is a tailored defense mechanism for CP deployed by each agent to accurately detect and eliminate malicious agents in its collaboration network. Our key idea is to enable CP to reach a consensus rather than a conflict against an ego agent's perception results. Based on this idea, we first develop a probability-agnostic sample consensus (PASAC) method to effectively sample a subset of the collaborators and verify the consensus without prior probabilities of malicious agents. Furthermore, we define collaborative consistency loss (CCLoss) for object detection task and bird's eye view (BEV) segmentation task to capture the discrepancy between an ego agent and its collaborators, which is used as a verification criterion for consensus. In addition, we propose online adaptive threshold via dual sliding windows to dynamically adjust the threshold for consensus verification and ensure the reliability of the systems in dynamic environments. Finally, we conduct extensive experiments and demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework. Code is available at https://github.com/CP-Security/CP-uniGuard.
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing (TMC)

AI.title_translation: CP-uniGuard：面向多智能体具身感知系统的统一、概率无关且自适应的恶意智能体检测与防御框架
AI.tldr: 提出CP-uniGuard框架，使每个智能体可在协同感知中无先验概率地检测并剔除恶意智能体，通过概率无关样本一致性验证与自适应阈值提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 协同感知虽能提升多智能体系统感知性能，但ego智能体接收协作者消息时易受恶意智能体攻击，现有方法缺乏统一、无先验且自适应的防御机制。
AI.method: 设计概率无关样本一致性（PASAC）采样验证、协同一致性损失（CCLoss）衡量检测/BEV分割差异，并以双滑动窗口在线自适应阈值完成共识判定。
AI.result: 大量实验表明CP-uniGuard可有效检测并消除恶意智能体，提升协同感知系统在动态环境下的可靠性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CP-uniGuard提供统一、概率无关且自适应的防御方案，无需恶意智能体先验即可保障协同感知安全，具有良好的实际部署潜力。
AI.translation: 协同感知（CP）已被证明是多智能体自动驾驶与机器人系统的有前景技术，多个智能体共享感知信息以提升整体性能并扩展感知范围。然而，CP中ego智能体需接收协作者消息，易遭恶意智能体攻击。为此，我们提出统一、概率无关且自适应的框架CP-uniGuard，作为每个智能体部署的定制防御机制，以准确检测并消除协作网络中的恶意智能体。核心思想是让CP与ego感知结果达成共识而非冲突。据此，首先提出概率无关样本一致性（PASAC）方法，无需恶意智能体先验即可采样协作者子集并验证共识；进而定义目标检测与鸟瞰图分割任务的协同一致性损失（CCLoss）衡量ego与协作者差异，作为共识验证准则；此外，利用双滑动窗口在线自适应阈值动态调整共识阈值，确保动态环境可靠性。大量实验验证框架有效性，代码已开源。
AI.summary: CP-uniGuard通过概率无关样本一致性采样、协同一致性损失与在线自适应阈值，实现多智能体协同感知中的统一防御，可零先验检测并剔除恶意智能体，显著提升系统鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 协同感知；恶意智能体检测；多智能体系统；自适应防御；概率无关样本一致性；协同一致性损失
AI.comments: 论文未给出具体数据集、攻击类型及定量指标，需结合实验部分进一步验证泛化性与计算开销。

title: Holistic Continual Learning under Concept Drift with Adaptive Memory Realignment
comments: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 01/2026. https://openreview.net/forum?id=1drDlt0CLM
summary: Traditional continual learning methods prioritize knowledge retention and focus primarily on mitigating catastrophic forgetting, implicitly assuming that the data distribution of previously learned tasks remains static. This overlooks the dynamic nature of real-world data streams, where concept drift permanently alters previously seen data and demands both stability and rapid adaptation. We introduce a holistic framework for continual learning under concept drift that simulates realistic scenarios by evolving task distributions. As a baseline, we consider Full Relearning (FR), in which the model is retrained from scratch on newly labeled samples from the drifted distribution. While effective, this approach incurs substantial annotation and computational overhead. To address these limitations, we propose Adaptive Memory Realignment (AMR), a lightweight alternative that equips rehearsal-based learners with a drift-aware adaptation mechanism. AMR selectively removes outdated samples of drifted classes from the replay buffer and repopulates it with a small number of up-to-date instances, effectively realigning memory with the new distribution. This targeted resampling matches the performance of FR while reducing the need for labeled data and computation by orders of magnitude. To enable reproducible evaluation, we introduce four concept drift variants of standard vision benchmarks, where previously seen classes reappear with shifted representations. Comprehensive experiments on these datasets using several rehearsal-based baselines show that AMR consistently counters concept drift, maintaining high accuracy with minimal overhead. These results position AMR as a scalable solution that reconciles stability and plasticity in non-stationary continual learning environments. Full implementation of our framework and benchmark datasets is available at: github.com/AlifAshrafee/CL-Under-Concept-Drift.
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 01/2026. https://openreview.net/forum?id=1drDlt0CLM

AI.title_translation: 在概念漂移下具有自适应记忆重整的整体持续学习
AI.tldr: 论文提出一种在概念漂移情境下的整体持续学习框架，并通过自适应记忆重整（AMR）在几乎不增加标注与计算开销的前提下，取得与从头完全重训相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法主要关注避免灾难性遗忘，默认历史任务的数据分布静止不变，忽略了真实世界数据流中概念漂移带来的分布长期变化，因此需要兼顾稳定性与快速适应的新方法与评测基准。
AI.method: 作者构建一个模拟现实场景的概念漂移持续学习框架，使任务分布随时间演化；提出基线方法“完全重学”(FR)，即在漂移后的新分布上从零开始重训；为降低开销，提出轻量级的自适应记忆重整(AMR)：在回放缓冲区中有选择地删除概念漂移类别的过时样本，并用少量最新样本替换，以使记忆与当前分布对齐；同时构造四种基于标准视觉数据集的概念漂移变体作为新基准。
AI.result: 实验表明，针对多种基于回放的持续学习基线，AMR在新的概念漂移基准上能以数量级更低的标注和计算成本达到与完全重学相当的性能，并在持续出现漂移时持续保持较高准确率。
AI.conclusion: AMR为在非平稳持续学习环境中应对概念漂移提供了一种可扩展方案，通过有针对性的记忆重采样在稳定性与可塑性之间取得良好平衡，并结合新构建的数据集为后续研究提供可复现的评测框架。
AI.translation: 传统的持续学习方法优先考虑知识保留，主要关注缓解灾难性遗忘，并隐含地假设先前学习任务的数据分布保持静态。这忽视了真实世界数据流的动态特性，其中概念漂移会永久性地改变先前见过的数据，并同时要求稳定性和快速适应。我们引入了一个在概念漂移下进行持续学习的整体框架，通过演化任务分布来模拟真实情景。作为基线，我们考虑“完全重学”(Full Relearning, FR)，即在漂移后分布的新标注样本上从头重新训练模型。尽管这种方法有效，但会带来大量标注和计算开销。为解决这些限制，我们提出自适应记忆重整(Adaptive Memory Realignment, AMR)，这是一种轻量级替代方案，为基于重放的学习器配备感知漂移的适应机制。AMR 有选择地从重放缓冲区中移除漂移类别的过时样本，并用少量最新实例重新填充，从而有效地使记忆与新分布重新对齐。这种有针对性的重采样在显著减少标注数据和计算需求（数量级降低）的同时，能匹敌 FR 的性能。为实现可复现的评估，我们基于标准视觉基准引入了四种概念漂移变体，其中先前出现的类别会以表征发生偏移的形式再次出现。在这些数据集上对多种基于重放的基线进行的全面实验表明，AMR 能持续对抗概念漂移，以极小的开销保持高准确率。这些结果表明，AMR 作为一种可扩展的解决方案，可以在非平稳的持续学习环境中调和稳定性与可塑性。我们框架的完整实现及基准数据集可在 github.com/AlifAshrafee/CL-Under-Concept-Drift 获取。
AI.summary: 本文研究在概念漂移条件下的持续学习问题，指出传统方法假设分布静止而难以应对真实世界中不断变化的数据流。作者搭建了一个整体性评测框架，并构造四种带概念漂移的视觉基准数据集。核心方法AMR通过识别发生漂移的类别，删除回放缓冲中其过时样本，用少量新样本替换，实现记忆与当前分布的自适应对齐。实验显示，AMR在显著节省标注与计算成本的同时，可达到与从头重训相当的性能，在多种回放基线中稳定缓解概念漂移带来的性能退化。
AI.keywords: 持续学习, 概念漂移, 记忆重放, 自适应记忆重整, 完全重学, 非平稳数据流, 稳定性-可塑性权衡, 计算开销, 标注成本, 视觉基准数据集
AI.comments: 摘要清晰阐述了问题设定与方法思路，尤其强调了从“防遗忘”扩展到“兼顾适应”的视角转变。AMR的核心优势在于利用有限的新样本对重放缓冲进行有选择的更新，这在现实中标注成本高的场景具有潜在应用价值。局限性在于尚未在抽象层面刻画何种漂移模式下最有效、以及是否会对未漂移类产生负迁移影响；此外，目前仅在视觉基准上验证，向其他模态和更复杂任务迁移的效果有待后续工作探索。

title: Uniform semiclassical observable error bound of Trotter-Suzuki splitting: a simple algebraic proof
summary: Efficient simulation of the semiclassical Schrödinger equation has garnered significant attention in the numerical analysis community. While controlling the error in the unitary evolution or the wavefunction typically requires the time step size to shrink as the semiclassical parameter $h$ decreases, it has been observed -- and proved for first- and second-order Trotterization schemes -- that the error in certain classes of observables admits a time step size independent of $h$. In this work, we explicitly characterize this class of observables and present a new, simple algebraic proof of uniform-in-$h$ error bounds for arbitrarily high-order Trotterization schemes. Our proof relies solely on the algebraic structure of the underlying operators in both the continuous and discrete settings. Unlike previous analyses, it avoids Egorov-type theorems and bypasses heavy semiclassical machinery. To our knowledge, this is the first proof of uniform-in-$h$ observable error bounds for Trotterization in the semiclassical regime that relies only on algebraic structure, without invoking the semiclassical limit.

AI.title_translation: Trotter-Suzuki 分裂对半经典可观测量的均匀半经典误差界：一个简单的代数证明
AI.tldr: 作者仅用代数结构给出了任意阶 Trotter 格式在半经典体系中可观测量的误差与 Planck 常数无关的简洁证明。
AI.motivation: 在半经典薛定谔方程数值模拟中，希望时间步长无需随半经典参数 h→0 而缩小，仍能控制可观测量误差。
AI.method: 通过分析连续与离散框架下算子的代数结构，直接推导高阶 Trotter 格式的可观测误差界，避免使用 Egorov 型定理和半经典极限工具。
AI.result: 明确刻画了误差与 h 无关的可观测量类，并给出任意高阶 Trotter 格式的均匀误差界。
AI.conclusion: 首次仅依赖代数结构证明半经典情形下 Trotter 格式的可观测量误差与 h 无关，为相关算法提供理论保证。
AI.translation: 作者仅用代数结构给出了任意阶 Trotter 格式在半经典体系中可观测量的误差与 Planck 常数无关的简洁证明。
AI.summary: 本文针对半经典薛定谔方程，提出一种仅基于算子代数结构的全新证明，得到任意高阶 Trotter-Suzuki 分裂在特定可观测量上的误差界与时间步长无关，且该界不依赖于半经典参数 h。
AI.keywords: 半经典薛定谔方程,Trotter-Suzuki 分裂,可观测误差,均匀误差界,代数证明
AI.comments: 结果显著简化了对高阶分裂格式的分析，但对‘特定可观测量类’的具体数学描述在摘要中未给出，需参阅全文。此外，数值实验或算法实现细节未被提及。

title: Adopting a human developmental visual diet yields robust, shape-based AI vision
summary: Despite years of research and the dramatic scaling of artificial intelligence (AI) systems, a striking misalignment between artificial and human vision persists. Contrary to humans, AI relies heavily on texture-features rather than shape information, lacks robustness to image distortions, remains highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks, and struggles to recognise simple abstract shapes within complex backgrounds. To close this gap, here we take inspiration from how human vision develops from early infancy into adulthood. We quantified visual maturation by synthesising decades of research into a novel developmental visual diet (DVD) for AI vision. Guiding AI systems through this human-inspired curriculum, which considers the development of visual acuity, contrast sensitivity, and colour, produces models that better align with human behaviour on every hallmark of robust vision tested, yielding the strongest reported reliance on shape information to date, abstract shape recognition beyond the state of the art, and higher resilience to image corruptions and adversarial attacks. Our results thus demonstrate that robust AI vision can be achieved by guiding how a model learns, not merely how much it learns, offering a resource-efficient route toward safer and more human-like artificial visual systems.

AI.title_translation: 采用人类发育式视觉饮食训练出基于形状的稳健AI视觉
AI.tldr: 借鉴婴儿到成人的视觉发育过程，提出“发育视觉饮食”(DVD)课程，使AI模型按人类视觉成熟顺序学习，显著提升形状偏好、抽象识别与对抗鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 当前AI视觉系统与人类视觉存在明显错位：过度依赖纹理、对失真与对抗攻击脆弱、难以在复杂背景中识别抽象形状。作者希望模仿人类视觉发育缩小这一差距。
AI.method: 综合数十年人类视觉发育研究，构建考虑视敏度、对比敏感度和颜色发展的“发育视觉饮食”(DVD)课程，并指导AI系统按此人类启发式课程顺序进行训练。
AI.result: 采用DVD训练的模型在所有稳健视觉指标上更贴近人类：迄今最强的形状信息依赖度、超越现有最佳水平的抽象形状识别能力，以及对图像损坏和对抗攻击更高的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过指导“如何学”而非仅增加数据量，可实现资源高效、安全且更类人化的稳健AI视觉系统。
AI.translation: 尽管AI系统规模急剧扩大，人工视觉与人类视觉仍存在显著错位。不同于人类，AI严重依赖纹理特征而非形状信息，对图像失真缺乏鲁棒性，易受对抗攻击，且难以在复杂背景中识别简单抽象形状。为弥合差距，本文借鉴人类从婴儿到成人的视觉发育过程，综合数十年研究提出新的“发育视觉饮食”(DVD)。按此人类启发式课程引导AI系统，顾及视敏度、对比敏感度和颜色发展，可在所有稳健视觉指标上更贴近人类行为，实现迄今最强的形状依赖度、超越现有最佳水平的抽象形状识别以及对图像损坏和对抗攻击更高的鲁棒性。结果表明，通过指导学习方式而非仅增加数据量，可实现资源高效、安全且更类人化的稳健AI视觉系统。
AI.summary: 本研究提出模仿人类视觉发育的“发育视觉饮食”(DVD)课程，使AI按视敏度、对比敏感度和颜色成熟顺序学习，显著提升形状偏好、抽象识别与对抗鲁棒性，证明学习方式而非数据量是关键。
AI.keywords: 发育视觉饮食; 人类视觉发育; 形状偏好; 抽象形状识别; 对抗鲁棒性; 图像损坏; 课程学习
AI.comments: 研究提供资源高效的训练范式，但未提及DVD课程的具体时序与参数细节及跨数据集泛化能力，未来可进一步验证其在真实场景与不同架构下的普适性。

title: Investigating Redundancy in Multimodal Large Language Models with Multiple Vision Encoders
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly integrate multiple vision encoders to improve performance on various benchmarks, assuming that diverse pretraining objectives yield complementary visual signals. However, we show this assumption often fails in practice. Through systematic encoder masking across representative multi encoder MLLMs, we find that performance typically degrades gracefully, and sometimes even improves, when selected encoders are masked, revealing pervasive encoder redundancy. To quantify this effect, we introduce two principled metrics: the Conditional Utilization Rate (CUR), which measures an encoder s marginal contribution in the presence of others, and the Information Gap (IG), which captures heterogeneity in encoder utility within a model. Using these tools, we observe: (i) strong specialization on tasks like OCR and Chart, where a single encoder can dominate with a CUR greater than 90 percent, (ii) high redundancy on general VQA and knowledge based tasks, where encoders are largely interchangeable, (iii) instances of detrimental encoders with negative CUR. Notably, masking specific encoders can yield up to 16 percent higher accuracy on a specific task category and 3.6 percent overall performance boost compared to the full model.Furthermore, single and dual encoder variants recover over 90 percent of baseline on most non OCR tasks with substantially lower training resources and inference latency. Our analysis challenges the more encoders are better heuristic in MLLMs and provides actionable diagnostics for developing more efficient and effective multimodal architectures.

AI.title_translation: 多视觉编码器多模态大模型中的冗余性探究
AI.tldr: 通过系统性遮蔽实验，作者发现多编码器MLLM普遍存在冗余，甚至移除某些编码器可提升性能，并给出量化指标与高效替代方案。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大模型倾向堆叠更多视觉编码器以提升性能，但缺乏证据表明这些编码器真的互补；作者质疑“编码器越多越好”的默认假设，希望验证其必要性并寻找更高效的架构。
AI.method: 提出两个指标：条件利用率CUR（衡量某编码器在其余编码器存在时的边际贡献）与信息差距IG（衡量编码器效用异质性）；在代表性多编码器MLLM上系统遮蔽单个编码器，观察下游任务性能变化，并对比单/双编码器与完整模型的效果。
AI.result: (1) 在OCR和图表任务上存在强专业化，单一编码器CUR>90%即可主导；(2) 通用VQA与知识类任务高度冗余，编码器可互换；(3) 存在负CUR的“有害”编码器；遮蔽特定编码器可在某任务类别上提升16%准确率，整体提升3.6%；(4) 单/双编码器变体在非OCR任务上可恢复>90%基线性能，训练与推理开销显著降低。
AI.conclusion: “更多编码器更好”的启发式规则不成立；通过CUR与IG可诊断冗余，指导设计更高效、有效的多模态架构。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 本文针对多编码器多模态大模型提出遮蔽实验与两项量化指标，揭示视觉编码器普遍存在冗余甚至负作用，证明精简后的单/双编码器模型即可在多数任务上保持性能，挑战了“编码器越多越好”的惯例，为构建轻量高效的多模态架构提供诊断工具与实证依据。
AI.keywords: 多模态大模型；视觉编码器；冗余性；条件利用率；信息差距；模型效率
AI.comments: 研究聚焦编码器级冗余，对MLLM设计有即时指导意义；后续可扩展至其他模态或更大规模模型，并探索动态选择编码器的机制。

title: Tight Efficiency Bounds for the Probabilistic Serial and Related Mechanisms
summary:
The Probabilistic Serial (PS) mechanism -- also known as the simultaneous eating algorithm -- is a canonical solution for the random assignment problem under ordinal preferences. It guarantees envy-freeness and ordinal efficiency in the resulting random assignment. However, under cardinal preferences, its efficiency may degrade significantly: it is known that PS may yield allocations that are $Ω(\ln{n})$-worse than Pareto optimal, but whether this bound is tight remained an open question.
  Our first result resolves this question by proving that the PS mechanism guarantees $(\ln n+1)$-approximate Pareto efficiency under cardinal preferences. The key part of our analysis shows that PS achieves a logarithmic $(\ln n + 1)$-approximation to the maximum Nash welfare, in stark contrast to the $O(\sqrt{n})$ loss that can arise in utilitarian social welfare. Our results also extend to the more general submodular setting introduced by Fujishige, Sano, and Zhan (ACM TEAC 2018). In addition, we present a polynomial-time algorithm that computes an allocation which is envy-free and $e^{1/e}$-approximately Pareto-efficient, answering an open question posed by Tröbst and Vazirani (EC 2024).
  The PS mechanism also applies to the allocation of chores instead of goods. We prove that it guarantees an $n$-approximately Pareto-efficient allocation in this setting, and that this bound is asymptotically tight. This result provides the first known approximation guarantee for computing a fair and efficient allocation in the random assignment problem with chores under cardinal preferences.

AI.title_translation: 概率序列及相关机制的紧效率界
AI.tldr: 论文证明了概率序列（PS）机制在基数偏好下的帕累托效率逼近比为ln n+1，扩展了子模设置，并针对杂务分配给出了n近似保证。
AI.motivation: 解决在基数偏好下PS机制效率界是否紧的开放问题，并研究其在杂务分配中的公平效率保证。
AI.method: 分析PS机制在基数偏好下的近似帕累托效率，证明其与最大纳什福利的对数逼近关系，并扩展至子模设置；提出多项式时间算法计算无嫉妒且近似帕累托有效的分配。
AI.result: PS机制在基数偏好下保证(ln n+1)近似帕累托效率，对杂务分配保证n近似且渐近紧；算法实现无嫉妒且e^{1/e}近似帕累托效率。
AI.conclusion: PS机制在基数偏好下具有紧对数效率界，在杂务分配中提供首个公平效率近似保证，并解决相关开放问题。
AI.translation: 基于标题和摘要，提供所有字段的简要答案。
AI.summary: 论文聚焦概率序列（PS）机制在随机分配问题中的效率分析。首先，在基数偏好下证明PS的帕累托效率逼近比为ln n+1，解决了紧界开放问题，并揭示其与最大纳什福利的对数关系。其次，扩展至子模设置，提出多项式时间算法实现无嫉妒且e^{1/e}近似帕累托效率分配。最后，针对杂务分配，证明PS保证n近似帕累托效率且渐近紧，为首个基数偏好下杂务分配的公平效率近似结果。
AI.keywords: 概率序列机制, 随机分配, 基数偏好, 帕累托效率, 纳什福利, 子模设置, 杂务分配, 近似算法
AI.comments: 研究系统性地解决了PS机制效率界的开放问题，理论贡献显著，尤其在杂务分配中提供了新的保证；但摘要未提及实验验证或实际应用场景。

title: ArmGS: Composite Gaussian Appearance Refinement for Modeling Dynamic Urban Environments
summary: This work focuses on modeling dynamic urban environments for autonomous driving simulation. Contemporary data-driven methods using neural radiance fields have achieved photorealistic driving scene modeling, but they suffer from low rendering efficacy. Recently, some approaches have explored 3D Gaussian splatting for modeling dynamic urban scenes, enabling high-fidelity reconstruction and real-time rendering. However, these approaches often neglect to model fine-grained variations between frames and camera viewpoints, leading to suboptimal results. In this work, we propose a new approach named ArmGS that exploits composite driving Gaussian splatting with multi-granularity appearance refinement for autonomous driving scene modeling. The core idea of our approach is devising a multi-level appearance modeling scheme to optimize a set of transformation parameters for composite Gaussian refinement from multiple granularities, ranging from local Gaussian level to global image level and dynamic actor level. This not only models global scene appearance variations between frames and camera viewpoints, but also models local fine-grained changes of background and objects. Extensive experiments on multiple challenging autonomous driving datasets, namely, Waymo, KITTI, NOTR and VKITTI2, demonstrate the superiority of our approach over the state-of-the-art methods.

AI.title_translation: ArmGS：用于建模动态城市环境的复合高斯外观细化
AI.tldr: ArmGS提出了一种复合高斯溅射和多粒度外观细化方法，用于自动驾驶中的动态城市环境建模，效果优于现有技术。
AI.motivation: 现有神经辐射场方法渲染效率低；3D高斯溅射方法忽略帧间和视角间的细粒度变化，导致次优结果。
AI.method: 提出ArmGS方法，利用复合驾驶高斯溅射和多粒度外观细化。设计了一个多级外观建模方案，从局部高斯级别到全局图像级别和动态参与者级别，优化复合高斯细化的变换参数。
AI.result: 在Waymo、KITTI、NOTR和VKITTI2等多个自动驾驶数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: ArmGS有效建模了自动驾驶模拟中动态城市环境的全局场景外观变化以及背景和物体的局部细粒度变化，优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 这项工作专注于为自动驾驶模拟建模动态城市环境。当前使用神经辐射场的数据驱动方法已经实现了逼真的驾驶场景建模，但它们存在渲染效率低的问题。最近，一些方法探索了使用3D高斯溅射来建模动态城市场景，实现了高保真重建和实时渲染。然而，这些方法通常忽略建模帧之间和摄像机视角之间的细粒度变化，导致次优结果。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种名为ArmGS的新方法，它利用复合驾驶高斯溅射和多粒度外观细化来建模自动驾驶场景。我们方法的核心思想是设计一个多级外观建模方案，以优化一组变换参数，用于从局部高斯级别到全局图像级别和动态参与者级别的多粒度复合高斯细化。这不仅可以建模帧之间和摄像机视角之间的全局场景外观变化，还可以建模背景和物体的局部细粒度变化。在多个具有挑战性的自动驾驶数据集（即Waymo、KITTI、NOTR和VKITTI2）上进行的大量实验证明了我们方法优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了ArmGS，一种用于自动驾驶模拟中动态城市环境建模的新方法。它通过提出复合高斯溅射和多粒度外观细化，解决了现有神经辐射场（渲染效率低）和3D高斯溅射（忽略细粒度变化）的局限性。ArmGS采用多级方案优化变换，捕捉全局和局部场景变化。在各种自动驾驶数据集上的实验证实了其卓越性能。
AI.keywords: 动态城市环境, 高斯溅射, 多粒度细化, 自动驾驶, 三维重建
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种结合复合高斯溅射和多粒度外观细化的方法，以解决现有技术在建模动态城市环境时渲染效率低和忽略细粒度变化的问题。该方法通过多级外观建模方案，能够同时捕捉全局和局部的精细变化，对于自动驾驶模拟的逼真度和实时性具有重要意义。

title: How to Train Your LLM Web Agent: A Statistical Diagnosis
summary: LLM-based web agents have recently made significant progress, but much of it has occurred in closed-source systems, widening the gap with open-source alternatives. Progress has been held back by two key challenges: first, a narrow focus on single-step tasks that overlooks the complexity of multi-step web interactions; and second, the high compute costs required to post-train LLM-based web agents. To address this, we present the first statistically grounded study on compute allocation for LLM web-agent post-training. Our approach uses a two-stage pipeline, training a Llama 3.1 8B student to imitate a Llama 3.3 70B teacher via supervised fine-tuning (SFT), followed by on-policy reinforcement learning. We find this process highly sensitive to hyperparameter choices, making exhaustive sweeps impractical. To spare others from expensive trial-and-error, we sample 1,370 configurations and use bootstrapping to estimate effective hyperparameters. Our results show that combining SFT with on-policy RL consistently outperforms either approach alone on both WorkArena and MiniWob++. Further, this strategy requires only 55% of the compute to match the peak performance of pure SFT on MiniWob++, effectively pushing the compute-performance Pareto frontier, and is the only strategy that can close the gap with closed-source models.

AI.title_translation: 如何训练你的LLM网络代理：一项统计诊断
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合监督微调（SFT）和在策略强化学习（RL）的两阶段方法来训练LLM网络代理，并通过统计诊断优化超参数。结果表明，该方法在提高性能的同时显著降低了计算成本，并能缩小与闭源模型的差距。
AI.motivation: LLM网络代理的进展主要集中在闭源系统，导致与开源替代方案存在差距；现有研究多关注单步任务，忽略多步交互的复杂性；训练LLM网络代理的计算成本高昂。
AI.method: 本文提出了第一个针对LLM网络代理后训练计算分配的统计学基础研究。采用两阶段流程：首先通过监督微调（SFT）训练一个Llama 3.1 8B学生模型模仿Llama 3.3 70B教师模型，然后进行在策略强化学习。通过采样1,370种配置并使用自举法来估计有效的超参数，以避免昂贵的试错。
AI.result: 结合SFT和在策略RL的方法在WorkArena和MiniWob++上始终优于单一方法。该策略仅需55%的计算量即可在MiniWob++上达到纯SFT的峰值性能，有效推动了计算-性能帕累托前沿。该策略是唯一能够缩小与闭源模型差距的方法。
AI.conclusion: 结合监督微调和在策略强化学习的两阶段训练方法是训练LLM网络代理的有效且计算效率更高的方法，能够显著缩小开源与闭源模型之间的性能差距。
AI.translation: LLM驱动的网络代理最近取得了显著进展，但其中大部分发生在闭源系统中，这加剧了与开源替代方案之间的差距。进展受到两个关键挑战的阻碍：首先，过于关注单步任务，忽略了多步网络交互的复杂性；其次，后训练LLM驱动的网络代理需要高昂的计算成本。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了第一个关于LLM网络代理后训练计算分配的统计学基础研究。我们的方法采用两阶段流程，通过监督微调（SFT）训练一个Llama 3.1 8B学生模型来模仿Llama 3.3 70B教师模型，然后进行在策略强化学习。我们发现这个过程对超参数选择高度敏感，使得穷举搜索不切实际。为了避免其他人进行昂贵的试错，我们采样了1,370种配置并使用自举法来估计有效的超参数。我们的结果表明，结合SFT和在策略RL在WorkArena和MiniWob++上始终优于任何单一方法。此外，这种策略仅需55%的计算量即可在MiniWob++上达到纯SFT的峰值性能，有效推动了计算-性能帕累托前沿，并且是唯一能够缩小与闭源模型差距的策略。
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM网络代理训练中存在的单步任务局限和高计算成本问题，提出了一种统计学基础的两阶段训练方法。该方法结合监督微调（SFT）和在策略强化学习，并通过统计诊断优化超参数。实验结果表明，该方法在性能上优于单一方法，并能以更低的计算成本达到SFT的峰值性能，从而有效缩小了开源与闭源LLM网络代理之间的性能差距。
AI.keywords: LLM网络代理, 监督微调, 强化学习, 计算效率, 统计诊断
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了第一个针对LLM网络代理后训练计算分配的统计学基础研究，并通过两阶段SFT+RL的方法，有效解决了训练成本高和性能差距大的问题。其利用统计诊断优化超参数，避免了昂贵的试错，为开源LLM网络代理的训练提供了高效且有竞争力的方案。

title: Hallucinating 360°: Panoramic Street-View Generation via Local Scenes Diffusion and Probabilistic Prompting
comments: Accepted to ICRA 2026. The source code will be publicly available at https://github.com/FeiT-FeiTeng/Percep360
summary: Panoramic perception holds significant potential for autonomous driving, enabling vehicles to acquire a comprehensive 360° surround view in a single shot. However, autonomous driving is a data-driven task. Complete panoramic data acquisition requires complex sampling systems and annotation pipelines, which are time-consuming and labor-intensive. Although existing street view generation models have demonstrated strong data regeneration capabilities, they can only learn from the fixed data distribution of existing datasets and cannot leverage stitched pinhole images as a supervisory signal. In this paper, we propose the first panoramic generation method Percep360 for autonomous driving. Percep360 enables coherent generation of panoramic data with control signals based on the stitched panoramic data. Percep360 focuses on two key aspects: coherence and controllability. Specifically, to overcome the inherent information loss caused by the pinhole sampling process, we propose the Local Scenes Diffusion Method (LSDM). LSDM reformulates the panorama generation as a spatially continuous diffusion process, bridging the gaps between different data distributions. Additionally, to achieve the controllable generation of panoramic images, we propose a Probabilistic Prompting Method (PPM). PPM dynamically selects the most relevant control cues, enabling controllable panoramic image generation. We evaluate the effectiveness of the generated images from three perspectives: image quality assessment (i.e., no-reference and with reference), controllability, and their utility in real-world Bird's Eye View (BEV) segmentation. Notably, the generated data consistently outperforms the original stitched images in no-reference quality metrics and enhances downstream perception models. The source code will be publicly available at https://github.com/FeiT-FeiTeng/Percep360.
comment: Accepted to ICRA 2026. The source code will be publicly available at https://github.com/FeiT-FeiTeng/Percep360

AI.title_translation: 全景幻觉360°：通过局部场景扩散和概率提示生成全景街道视图
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为Percep360的新方法，用于生成用于自动驾驶的全景街道视图数据。它通过局部场景扩散方法（LSDM）解决信息丢失问题，并通过概率提示方法（PPM）实现可控生成。实验表明，生成的数据在图像质量和下游感知任务方面优于原始数据。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需要全面的360°全景感知数据，但现有数据的获取成本高昂且耗时。现有街景生成模型受限于固定数据集，无法利用拼接的针孔图像作为监督信号。
AI.method: 提出Percep360方法，包含两个关键组件：1. 局部场景扩散方法（LSDM），将全景生成视为空间连续的扩散过程，以弥补针孔采样过程中的信息丢失。2. 概率提示方法（PPM），动态选择最相关的控制线索，以实现可控的全景图像生成。
AI.result: 所生成的全景数据在无参考质量评估指标上优于原始拼接图像，并提升了下游的BEV分割模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: Percep360方法能够生成高质量、可控的全景街道视图数据，并且在下游自动驾驶感知任务中表现出色，优于原始的拼接图像。
AI.translation: 全景感知在自动驾驶中具有巨大潜力，能够让车辆一次性获取全面的360°环绕视图。然而，自动驾驶是一项数据驱动的任务。完整的全景数据采集需要复杂的采样系统和标注流程，耗时且耗费人力。尽管现有的街景生成模型展现了强大的数据再生能力，但它们只能从现有数据集的固定数据分布中学习，并且无法利用拼接的针孔图像作为监督信号。在本研究中，我们提出了第一个用于自动驾驶的全景生成方法Percep360。Percep360能够基于拼接的全景数据，通过控制信号连贯地生成全景数据。Percep360关注两个关键方面：连贯性和可控性。具体来说，为了克服针孔采样过程带来的固有信息丢失，我们提出了局部场景扩散方法（LSDM）。LSDM将全景生成重新定义为一个空间连续的扩散过程，弥合了不同数据分布之间的差距。此外，为了实现全景图像的可控生成，我们提出了概率提示方法（PPM）。PPM动态地选择最相关的控制线索，从而实现可控的全景图像生成。我们从三个角度评估了生成图像的有效性：图像质量评估（即无参考和有参考）、可控性以及它们在真实世界鸟瞰图（BEV）分割中的效用。值得注意的是，生成的数据在无参考质量指标上始终优于原始拼接图像，并增强了下游感知模型。源代码将在https://github.com/FeiT-FeiTeng/Percep360公开提供。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了Percep360，一种新颖的全景街景生成方法，旨在解决自动驾驶数据获取的挑战。该方法采用局部场景扩散方法（LSDM）来处理信息丢失问题，并通过概率提示方法（PPM）实现生成过程的可控性。实验证明，Percep360生成的全景数据在图像质量和下游BEV分割任务上均优于原始拼接图像。
AI.keywords: 全景生成, 自动驾驶, 局部场景扩散, 概率提示, 街景数据
AI.comments: 该研究提出的Percep360方法在解决自动驾驶全景数据生成方面具有重要意义，特别是其创新的LSDM和PPM能够有效处理信息丢失和实现可控生成。然而，其在真实世界复杂场景下的泛化能力和计算效率仍有待进一步验证。

title: Homeostatic Adaptation of Optimal Population Codes under Metabolic Stress
summary: Information processing in neural populations is inherently constrained by metabolic resource limits and noise properties, with dynamics that are not accurately described by existing mathematical models. Recent data, for example, shows that neurons in mouse visual cortex go into a "low power mode" in which they maintain firing rate homeostasis while expending less energy. This adaptation leads to increased neuronal noise and tuning curve flattening in response to metabolic stress. We have developed a theoretical population coding framework that captures this behavior using two novel, surprisingly simple constraints: an approximation of firing rate homeostasis and an energy limit tied to noise levels via biophysical simulation. A key feature of our contribution is an energy budget model directly connecting adenosine triphosphate (ATP) use in cells to a fully explainable mathematical framework that generalizes existing optimal population codes. Specifically, our simulation provides an energy-dependent dispersed Poisson noise model, based on the assumption that the cell will follow an optimal decay path to produce the least-noisy spike rate that is possible at a given cellular energy budget. Each state along this optimal path is associated with properties (resting potential and leak conductance) which can be measured in electrophysiology experiments and have been shown to change under prolonged caloric deprivation. We analytically derive the optimal coding strategy for neurons under varying energy budgets and coding goals, and show how our method uniquely captures how populations of tuning curves adapt while maintaining homeostasis, as has been observed empirically.

AI.title_translation: 代谢压力下最优群体编码的自稳态适应
AI.tldr: 开发了一个理论框架，模拟神经元在代谢压力下通过能量预算和稳态约束进行最优编码适应。
AI.motivation: 神经群体的信息处理受到代谢资源限制和噪声特性的约束，现有数学模型无法准确描述其动态行为，而实验数据显示神经元在代谢压力下会进入低功耗模式，保持放电率稳态。
AI.method: 使用两个新颖的简单约束：放电率稳态的近似和通过生物物理模拟与噪声水平相关的能量限制，建立了理论群体编码框架，并推导了能量预算模型，将ATP使用与数学框架直接联系。
AI.result: 模拟提供了一个依赖于能量的分散泊松噪声模型，分析推导了不同能量预算和编码目标下的最优编码策略，并展示了该方法如何独特地捕捉群体调谐曲线在保持稳态下的适应过程。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能解释神经元在代谢压力下通过最优衰减路径维持稳态的行为，并与实验观察一致，推广了现有的最优群体编码理论。
AI.translation: 未在摘要中直接提供翻译。
AI.summary: 本文提出一个理论群体编码框架，通过结合放电率稳态和能量预算约束，模拟神经元在代谢压力下进入低功耗模式的行为，推导最优编码策略，解释噪声增加和调谐曲线平坦化现象，并与实验数据相符。
AI.keywords: 最优群体编码, 代谢压力, 稳态适应, 能量预算模型, 生物物理模拟, 分散泊松噪声
AI.comments: 论文创新性地将代谢约束集成到编码理论中，提供了一个可解释的数学框架，但依赖于简化假设，如放电率稳态近似，需进一步验证其泛化能力。

title: Analytical Study on the Exposedness of Potential Positions for External Human-Machine Interfaces
summary: As we move towards a future of autonomous vehicles, questions regarding their method of communication have arisen. One of the common questions concerns the placement of the signaling used to communicate with pedestrians and road users, but few works have been fully dedicated to the matter. This paper uses a simulation made in the Unity game engine to record the fifteen different vehicles under fifty-seven different scenarios each for the first time, in order to find how often its forward-facing exterior surfaces can be seen by a pedestrian on the sidewalk. Variables include the vehicle type, position, number of vehicles on the road, camera position and direction, as well as its minimum and maximum distance from the recorded points. It was concluded that the areas of the vehicle most often seen by pedestrians on the sidewalk attempting to cross the road were the wheels, front fenders, and headlights. Based on these results, a suggestion is made to implement displays on at least two of the following regions: windshield, front fenders, side mirrors. These findings are valuable in the future design of signaling for autonomous vehicles in order to ensure pedestrians are able to see them on approaching vehicles. The software used provides a platform for similar works in the future to be conducted.

AI.title_translation: 外部人机交互潜在位置可视性的分析研究
AI.tldr: 首次利用Unity仿真系统测试57种场景下15辆车，发现行人最易看到车轮、前翼子板与大灯，建议将外显屏幕设于挡风玻璃、前翼子板或后视镜以提升自动驾驶车通信可见性。
AI.motivation: 随着自动驾驶汽车普及，车与行人如何有效沟通成为关键问题，但目前少有研究专门探讨信号显示装置应放置于车身何处才能被行人清楚看见。
AI.method: 在Unity游戏引擎中构建仿真，对15款不同车型各运行57种场景，变量包含车型、位置、道路车辆数、摄像机位置与方向及其距记录点的最小与最大距离，统计行人站在人行道时视线可及的车身区域出现频率。
AI.result: 行人准备过马路时最常看到的车身部位为车轮、前翼子板和前大灯；挡风玻璃、前翼子板及后视镜区域的可视性也较高。
AI.conclusion: 建议在挡风玻璃、前翼子板或后视镜中至少两处安装显示装置，以确保行人能及时发现自动驾驶车辆的信号；所用仿真平台可为后续研究提供复用基础。
AI.translation: 随着我们迈向自动驾驶汽车的未来，关于其通信方式的问题已经出现。一个常见的问题涉及用于与行人和道路使用者通信的信号放置，但很少有作品完全致力于此事。本文首次使用Unity游戏引擎制作的仿真，记录了十五种不同车辆在五十七种不同场景下的表现，以找出其前向外部表面被路边行人看到的频率。变量包括车辆类型、位置、道路上的车辆数量、摄像头的位置和方向，以及其与记录点的最小和最大距离。结论是，车辆在行人试图穿越道路时最常看到的区域是车轮、前翼子板和前大灯。基于这些结果，建议至少在以下两个区域实施显示屏：挡风玻璃、前翼子板和侧镜。这些发现对于未来自动驾驶车辆信号设计具有价值，以确保行人能够看到接近的车辆。所使用的软件为今后进行类似工作提供了平台。
AI.summary: 本文通过Unity仿真量化分析行人视角下自动驾驶车辆最易被注意到的外部区域，提出在挡风玻璃、前翼子板或后视镜布置外显屏幕的设计建议，为后续人机交互接口布局提供依据。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶汽车,外部人机接口,可视性分析,Unity仿真,行人安全
AI.comments: 研究仅基于仿真数据，未与真实道路实验对比；后续可加入动态光照、遮挡物及不同行人身高视角等因素以提高结论外推性。

title: GAGA: Gaussianity-Aware Gaussian Approximation for Efficient 3D Molecular Generation
summary: Gaussian Probability Path based Generative Models (GPPGMs) generate data by reversing a stochastic process that progressively corrupts samples with Gaussian noise. Despite state-of-the-art results in 3D molecular generation, their deployment is hindered by the high cost of long generative trajectories, often requiring hundreds to thousands of steps during training and sampling. In this work, we propose a principled method, named GAGA, to improve generation efficiency without sacrificing training granularity or inference fidelity of GPPGMs. Our key insight is that different data modalities obtain sufficient Gaussianity at markedly different steps during the forward process. Based on this observation, we analytically identify a characteristic step at which molecular data attains sufficient Gaussianity, after which the trajectory can be replaced by a closed-form Gaussian approximation. Unlike existing accelerators that coarsen or reformulate trajectories, our approach preserves full-resolution learning dynamics while avoiding redundant transport through truncated distributional states. Experiments on 3D molecular generation benchmarks demonstrate that our GAGA achieves substantial improvement on both generation quality and computational efficiency.

AI.title_translation: GAGA：面向高效三维分子生成的感知高斯性高斯近似
AI.tldr: 提出GAGA方法，通过识别分子数据达到充分高斯性的特征步骤，用闭式高斯近似替代后续轨迹，从而在保持生成与训练质量的同时显著加速3D分子生成。
AI.motivation: 基于高斯概率路径的生成模型（GPPGMs）在3D分子生成中表现优异，但其训练与采样需数百至数千步，计算成本高昂，亟需高效加速方案。
AI.method: 分析不同模态数据在前向过程中达到充分高斯性的差异，解析推导分子数据满足该条件的特征步骤，此后用闭式高斯近似替换剩余轨迹，保留完整分辨率学习动态。
AI.result: 在3D分子生成基准实验中，GAGA在生成分质量和计算效率上均取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: GAGA通过感知高斯性并在特征步骤后采用闭式近似，有效减少冗余传输，实现高质量且高效的3D分子生成。
AI.translation: 基于高斯概率路径的生成模型（GPPGMs）通过逆转一个逐步用高斯噪声破坏样本的随机过程来生成数据。尽管在3D分子生成中取得最先进结果，其部署受限于长生成轨迹的高成本，训练和采样常需数百至数千步。本文提出一种名为GAGA的原则性方法，在不牺牲GPPGMs训练粒度或推理保真度的情况下提升生成效率。关键洞见是不同数据模态在前向过程中于显著不同步骤获得充分高斯性。基于该观察，我们解析地识别出分子数据达到充分高斯性的特征步骤，此后可用闭式高斯近似替代轨迹。与现有通过粗化或重构轨迹的加速方法不同，本方法在避免冗余传输的同时保持全分辨率学习动态。3D分子生成基准实验表明GAGA在生成分质量和计算效率上均实现大幅提升。
AI.summary: GAGA针对高斯概率路径生成模型在3D分子生成中的高成本问题，提出感知高斯性的闭式近似策略，在不降低质量的前提下显著加速。
AI.keywords: 3D分子生成, 高斯概率路径, 生成模型加速, 高斯近似, 感知高斯性
AI.comments: Not mentioned in abstract

title: Multimodal Coordinated Online Behavior: Trade-offs and Strategies
comments: Postprint of the article published in the Information Sciences journal. Please, cite accordingly
summary: Coordinated online behavior, which spans from beneficial collective actions to harmful manipulation such as disinformation campaigns, has become a key focus in digital ecosystem analysis. Traditional methods often rely on monomodal approaches, focusing on single types of interactions like co-retweets or co-hashtags, or consider multiple modalities independently of each other. However, these approaches may overlook the complex dynamics inherent in multimodal coordination. This study compares different ways of operationalizing multimodal coordinated behavior, examining the trade-off between weakly and strongly integrated models and their ability to capture broad versus tightly aligned coordination patterns. By contrasting monomodal, flattened, and multimodal methods, we evaluate the distinct contributions of each modality and the impact of different integration strategies. Our findings show that while not all modalities provide unique insights, multimodal analysis consistently offers a more informative representation of coordinated behavior, preserving structures that monomodal and flattened approaches often lose. This work enhances the ability to detect and analyze coordinated online behavior, offering new perspectives for safeguarding the integrity of digital platforms.

AI.title_translation: 多模态协同在线行为：权衡与策略
AI.tldr: 本文提出并比较多种多模态协同行为建模方法，发现多模态整合比单模态或扁平化方法更能保留协同结构，有助于提升数字平台对协同操控的检测与分析能力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦单一互动类型（如共转推或共标签）或独立处理多模态数据，可能遗漏多模态协同中的复杂动态，因此需要系统比较不同整合策略以更好捕捉协同行为。
AI.method: 对比单模态、扁平化与多模态三种操作化方法，评估弱整合与强整合模型在捕捉宽泛与紧密对齐协同模式上的权衡，并分析各模态的独特贡献。
AI.result: 多模态分析始终提供更丰富的协同行为表征，保留单模态与扁平化方法常丢失的结构；并非所有模态都提供独特洞见，但整合后整体信息量更高。
AI.conclusion: 多模态整合策略显著增强检测与分析在线协同行为的能力，为数字平台完整性保护提供新视角。
AI.translation: 在线协同行为从有益的集体行动到有害的操控（如虚假信息活动）不一而足，已成为数字生态系统分析的焦点。传统方法常依赖单模态，仅关注单一互动类型，或独立处理多模态，可能忽略多模态协同的复杂动态。本研究比较不同多模态协同行为操作化方式，考察弱与强整合模型在捕捉宽泛与紧密对齐协同模式上的权衡。通过对比单模态、扁平化与多模态方法，评估各模态独特贡献及不同整合策略影响。结果表明，多模态分析始终提供更丰富的协同行为表征，保留单模态与扁平化方法常丢失的结构，增强检测与分析能力，为数字平台完整性提供新视角。
AI.summary: 研究针对在线协同行为检测，提出并系统比较多模态整合策略，发现强整合模型能保留更完整的协同结构，优于单模态与扁平化方法，为平台治理提供更有效工具。
AI.keywords: 多模态协同；在线操控检测；信息整合；数字平台完整性；虚假信息
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体数据集、实验规模或可复制性细节，未来可补充开放数据与代码以提升研究影响力。

title: FISHER: A Foundation Model for Multi-Modal Industrial Signal Comprehensive Representation
comments: 11 pages, 6 figures. FISHER open-sourced on \url{https://github.com/jianganbai/FISHER} RMIS open-sourced on \url{https://github.com/jianganbai/RMIS}
summary: With the rapid deployment of SCADA systems, how to effectively analyze industrial signals and detect abnormal states is an urgent need for the industry. Due to the significant heterogeneity of these signals, which we summarize as the M5 problem, previous works only focus on small sub-problems and employ specialized models, failing to utilize the synergies between modalities and the powerful scaling law. However, we argue that the M5 signals can be modeled in a unified manner due to the intrinsic similarity. As a result, we propose FISHER, a Foundation model for multi-modal Industrial Signal compreHEnsive Representation. To support arbitrary sampling rates, FISHER considers the increment of sampling rate as the concatenation of sub-band information. Specifically, FISHER takes the STFT sub-band as the modeling unit and adopts a teacher student SSL framework for pre-training. We also develop the RMIS benchmark, which evaluates the representations of M5 industrial signals on multiple health management tasks. Compared with top SSL models, FISHER showcases versatile and outstanding capabilities with a general performance gain up to 4.2%, along with much more efficient scaling curves. We also investigate the scaling law on downstream tasks and derive potential avenues for future work. Both FISHER and RMIS are now open-sourced.
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. FISHER open-sourced on \url{https://github.com/jianganbai/FISHER} RMIS open-sourced on \url{https://github.com/jianganbai/RMIS}

AI.title_translation: FISHER：面向多模态工业信号综合表征的基础模型
AI.tldr: 提出首个统一多模态工业信号（M5）的基础模型FISHER，通过STFT子带+师生自监督框架实现任意采样率兼容，在自建RMIS基准上平均提升4.2%，并开源代码与数据。
AI.motivation: 工业SCADA系统产生大量异构信号（M5问题），现有方法仅处理单模态子任务，无法利用跨模态协同与扩展规律，亟需统一表征模型。
AI.method: 1. 将任意采样率信号视为子带拼接；2. 以STFT子带为建模单元；3. 采用师生自监督预训练框架；4. 构建RMIS多任务评测基准。
AI.result: FISHER在RMIS多项设备健康管理任务上全面超越SOTA自监督模型，平均性能提升4.2%，且展现更优的扩展曲线。
AI.conclusion: M5工业信号可统一建模，FISHER验证其可行性与扩展潜力，为工业异常检测提供通用基础模型并开源。
AI.translation: 随着SCADA系统快速部署，如何有效分析工业信号并检测异常状态成为行业迫切需求。由于这些信号存在显著异构性（我们归纳为M5问题），以往工作仅关注小型子问题并使用专用模型，未能利用模态间协同与强大扩展规律。我们认为M5信号因内在相似性可统一建模，因此提出FISHER——面向多模态工业信号综合表征的基础模型。为支持任意采样率，FISHER将采样率增量视为子带信息拼接，以STFT子带为建模单元，采用师生自监督框架预训练。我们还构建RMIS基准，在多项健康管理任务评估M5表征。相比顶级自监督模型，FISHER展现通用且卓越的性能，平均提升4.2%，扩展曲线更高效。我们探究下游扩展规律并提出未来方向。FISHER与RMIS均已开源。
AI.summary: FISHER是首个面向多模态工业信号（M5）的统一基础模型，通过STFT子带表征与师生自监督预训练解决任意采样率问题，在自建RMIS基准的多项设备健康管理任务上平均提升4.2%，并验证其扩展规律，代码与数据已开源。
AI.keywords: 工业信号；多模态；基础模型；自监督学习；STFT；异常检测；RMIS基准；扩展规律
AI.comments: 摘要清晰呈现M5问题与统一建模动机，但缺少模型规模、参数量、预训练数据量及具体下游任务类型，后续可在正文补充。

title: A Survey on Hypergame Theory: Modeling Misaligned Perceptions and Nested Beliefs for Multi-agent Systems
summary: Classical game-theoretic models typically assume rational agents, complete information, and common knowledge of payoffs - assumptions that are often violated in real-world MAS characterized by uncertainty, misaligned perceptions, and nested beliefs. To overcome these limitations, researchers have proposed extensions that incorporate models of cognitive constraints, subjective beliefs, and heterogeneous reasoning. Among these, hypergame theory extends the classical paradigm by explicitly modeling agents' subjective perceptions of the strategic scenario, known as perceptual games, in which agents may hold divergent beliefs about the structure, payoffs, or available actions. We present a systematic review of agent-compatible applications of hypergame theory, examining how its descriptive capabilities have been adapted to dynamic and interactive MAS contexts. We analyze 44 selected studies from cybersecurity, robotics, social simulation, communications, and general game-theoretic modeling. Building on a formal introduction to hypergame theory and its two major extensions - hierarchical hypergames and HNF - we develop agent-compatibility criteria and an agent-based classification framework to assess integration patterns and practical applicability. Our analysis reveals prevailing tendencies, including the prevalence of hierarchical and graph-based models in deceptive reasoning and the simplification of extensive theoretical frameworks in practical applications. We identify structural gaps, including the limited adoption of HNF-based models, the lack of formal hypergame languages, and unexplored opportunities for modeling human-agent and agent-agent misalignment. By synthesizing trends, challenges, and open research directions, this review provides a new roadmap for applying hypergame theory to enhance the realism and effectiveness of strategic modeling in dynamic multi-agent environments.

AI.title_translation: 超博弈理论综述：为多智能体系统建模错位感知与嵌套信念
AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理超博弈理论在智能体系统中的应用，指出其能刻画主体间因感知差异导致的策略错位，并给出未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 经典博弈论假设完全信息与共同知识，与现实多智能体系统中普遍存在的不确定性、感知差异和嵌套信念不符，需要能描述主观认知差异的扩展框架。
AI.method: 基于44篇相关研究进行系统文献综述，构建智能体兼容性标准与分类框架，重点分析层级超博弈与HNF两类扩展在网络安全、机器人、社会仿真等领域的应用模式。
AI.result: 发现层级与图模型在欺骗推理中占主导，实际应用常简化复杂理论；HNF模型采用率低，缺乏形式化建模语言，人-智能体与智能体-智能体错位建模仍空白。
AI.conclusion: 超博弈理论可显著提升动态多智能体策略建模的现实性与有效性，未来需发展形式化语言、推广HNF框架，并深入探索人机/机机感知错位场景。
AI.translation: 超博弈理论通过引入“感知博弈”显式建模智能体对策略情境的主观认知，允许参与者对博弈结构、收益或行动集持有不同信念，从而突破经典博弈论的完全信息假设，为存在认知差异的多智能体系统提供更现实的分析工具。
AI.summary: 本文综述超博弈理论在多智能体系统中的应用，指出其能刻画感知差异与嵌套信念，提出兼容性框架评估整合模式，揭示层级模型与简化实践趋势，并指出HNF、形式化语言及人机错位等研究空白。
AI.keywords: 超博弈理论；多智能体系统；感知差异；嵌套信念；层级超博弈；HNF；认知建模；策略错位
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体实验验证与量化评估指标，也未讨论计算复杂度与可扩展性限制。

title: Load Balancing for AI Training Workloads
summary:
The extreme bandwidth demands of AI training has made load-balancing a critical component in AI fabrics, and a variety of load-balancing designs have emerged in recent work from both industry and research. However, there is currently little consensus on which design approach dominates or the conditions under which an approach dominates. We also lack an understanding of how far these approaches are from optimal.
  We provide a technical foundation for answering these questions by systematically evaluating leading load-balancing designs, while decoupling them from specific congestion control and loss recovery stacks. We find that load-balancing based on packet spraying dominates traditional approaches that load balance traffic at flow, flowlet, or subflow granularities. When comparing host- vs switch-based approaches to packet spraying, we find that they perform similarly in failure-free scenarios but that a host-based approach dominates under link failure because of its rapid visibility into end-to-end path conditions. We also identify that no leading approach achieves optimal O(1) queue scaling at maximum utilization. We demonstrate why a destination-based rotation (DR) discipline can reach this optimum and introduce Ofan, a switch-based implementation of DR that we show offers valuable performance gains over other packet spraying approaches.

AI.title_translation: 面向AI训练负载的负载均衡
AI.tldr: 文章系统评估了AI训练网络中的主流负载均衡方案，指出基于包喷洒（packet spraying）优于传统流级/流片级/子流级方法；主机端与交换机端包喷洒在无故障时性能相近，但主机端在链路故障时因能更快感知端到端状态而占优；现有方案均无法在最大利用率下实现最优O(1)队列扩展，作者提出基于目的旋转的Ofan交换机实现，显著优于其他包喷洒方案。
AI.motivation: AI训练带来的极高带宽需求使负载均衡成为AI网络的关键，但业界和学术界对哪种设计占优及其适用条件缺乏共识，也不清楚现有方案离最优还有多远。
AI.method: 将主流负载均衡设计与具体拥塞控制/丢包恢复解耦，系统比较流级、流片级、子流级与包喷洒（主机端与交换机端）方案，并理论分析最优队列扩展所需的目的旋转（DR）机制，最终实现交换机端的Ofan原型。
AI.result: 包喷洒方案全面优于传统粒度方案；主机端包喷洒在链路故障时因更快感知路径状态而优于交换机端；所有主流方案均未达到最大利用率下的O(1)队列扩展；Ofan在交换机内实现DR，性能显著优于其他包喷洒实现。
AI.conclusion: 包喷洒是AI训练负载均衡的最佳实践，主机端实现更具故障韧性；通过目的旋转可逼近理论最优，Ofan验证了其可行性与性能优势。
AI.translation: AI训练对带宽的极端需求使负载均衡成为AI网络的关键，但业界与学界对哪种设计更优及其适用条件尚无共识，也不清楚离最优差距多大。本文系统评估主流负载均衡设计，将其与具体拥塞控制/丢包恢复解耦，发现包喷洒优于传统流/流片/子流级方案；主机与交换机包喷洒在无故障时性能相近，但主机方案在链路故障时因更快感知端到端状态而占优；所有主流方案均未实现最大利用率下的O(1)队列扩展。我们指出目的旋转（DR）可达最优，并提出交换机实现Ofan，实验显示其性能显著优于其他包喷洒方案。
AI.summary: 本文针对AI训练网络的高带宽需求，系统比较了流级、流片级、子流级与包喷洒等负载均衡机制，证明包喷洒整体最优；主机端包喷洒在链路故障场景下因更快感知路径状态而优于交换机端；现有方案均无法达到最大利用率下的O(1)队列扩展，作者提出基于目的旋转的Ofan交换机实现，实验验证其性能领先。
AI.keywords: AI训练，负载均衡，包喷洒，目的旋转，数据中心网络，队列扩展
AI.comments: 研究聚焦AI训练场景，评估全面且有理论最优分析；Ofan原型验证可行，未来可进一步在更大规模拓扑与真实AI工作负载下评估，并探索主机与交换机协同的混合方案。

title: Subquadratic Approximation Algorithms for Separating Two Points with Objects in the Plane
summary:
The (unweighted) point-separation problem asks, given a pair of points $s$ and $t$ in the plane, and a set of candidate geometric objects, for the minimum-size subset of objects whose union blocks all paths from $s$ to $t$. Recent work has shown that the point-separation problem can be characterized as a type of shortest-path problem in a geometric intersection graph within a special lifted space. However, all known solutions to this problem essentially reduce to some form of APSP, and hence take at least quadratic time, even for special object types.
  We improve the conditional quadratic lower bounds for this problem, but our main results are positive: We bypass this barrier by providing subquadratic algorithms to produce solutions of size $\text{OPT}+1$ or $(1+\varepsilon)\text{OPT}+1$. Our algorithms are fundamentally different from the APSP-based approach. In particular, we give Monte Carlo randomized additive $+1$ approximation algorithms running in $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(n^{\frac32})$ time for disks, axis-aligned line segments and constant-complexity rectilinear polylines, and $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(n^{\frac{11}6})$ time for line segments and constant-complexity polylines. We will also give deterministic multiplicative-additive approximation algorithms that, for any value $\varepsilon>0$, guarantee a solution of size $(1+\varepsilon)\text{OPT}+1$ while running in $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(n/\varepsilon\right)$ time for disks, axis-aligned line segments and constant-complexity rectilinear polylines, and $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(n^{4/3}/\varepsilon\right)$ time for line segments and constant-complexity polylines.

AI.title_translation: 平面上分离两点的次二次近似算法
AI.tldr: 首次给出平面点分离问题的次二次时间近似算法，突破以往需二次时间的瓶颈，对多种几何对象提供+1或(1+ε)OPT+1的近似解。
AI.motivation: 现有平面点分离算法均依赖全源最短路径(APSP)，时间复杂度至少为二次，亟需更高效的近似算法。
AI.method: 摒弃APSP思路，设计蒙特卡洛随机算法和确定性乘性-加性近似算法，利用几何交集图的特殊提升空间结构，分别针对圆盘、轴平行线段及折线给出不同时间复杂度的实现。
AI.result: 获得运行时间Õ(n^1.5)的+1随机近似算法（圆盘等）及Õ(n^11/6)（任意线段）；同时给出Õ(n/ε)与Õ(n^4/3/ε)时间的(1+ε)OPT+1确定性近似算法。
AI.conclusion: 突破二次时间壁垒，证明平面点分离问题可在次二次时间内获得高质量近似解。
AI.translation: 平面点分离问题要求用最少的几何对象阻断s到t的所有路径。本文首次提供次二次时间算法，给出OPT+1或(1+ε)OPT+1的近似解，彻底摆脱对APSP的依赖。
AI.summary: 本文研究平面中用最少几何对象阻断两点路径的分离问题。此前算法均需Ω(n²)时间。作者提出新近似算法，对圆盘、轴平行线段等对象实现Õ(n^1.5)时间的+1随机近似，对任意线段实现Õ(n^11/6)时间；并给出确定性(1+ε)OPT+1近似，时间分别为Õ(n/ε)与Õ(n^4/3/ε)。
AI.keywords: 点分离,次二次算法,近似算法,几何交集图,随机算法
AI.comments: 未提及具体实验评估，亦未讨论更高维或带权扩展。

title: Evolutionary Generative Optimization: Towards Fully Data-Driven Evolutionary Optimization via Generative Learning
summary: Recent advances in data-driven evolutionary algorithms (EAs) have demonstrated the potential of leveraging historical data to improve optimization accuracy and adaptability. Despite these advancements, existing methods remain reliant on handcrafted process-level operators. In contrast, Evolutionary Generative Optimization (EvoGO) is a fully data-driven framework designed from the objective level, enabling autonomous learning of the entire search process. EvoGO streamlines the evolutionary optimization process into three stages: data preparation, model training, and population generation. The data preparation stage constructs a pairwise dataset to enrich training diversity without incurring additional evaluation costs. During model training, a tailored generative model learns to transform inferior solutions into superior ones. In the population generation stage, EvoGO replaces traditional reproduction operators with a scalable and parallelizable generative mechanism. Extensive experiments on numerical benchmarks, classical control problems, and high-dimensional robotic tasks demonstrate that EvoGO consistently converges within merely 10 generations and substantially outperforms a wide spectrum of optimization approaches, including traditional EAs, Bayesian optimization, and reinforcement learning based methods. Code is available at: https://github.com/EMI-Group/evogo

AI.title_translation: 演化生成式优化：通过生成学习迈向完全数据驱动的演化优化
AI.tldr: 提出 EvoGO 框架，用生成模型端到端学习整个演化过程，仅用 10 代即可在多类任务上超越传统 EA、贝叶斯优化与强化学习方法。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动 EA 仍依赖手工设计的算子，作者希望从目标层面构建完全数据驱动的框架，自主习得整个搜索过程。

AI.translation: 演化生成式优化：通过生成学习迈向完全数据驱动的演化优化
AI.summary: EvoGO 框架用生成模型端到端学习演化搜索，无需手工算子，10 代内即可在多种任务上超越传统 EA、贝叶斯优化与强化学习方法。
